Aphir would tease his daughter. "What do you see, my jewel?" he would say, for his daughter never fixated her hyaline eyes upon the limbed figures and faces tending the grove before her, but would instead cast them into the black yonder beyond the Spindle to gleam in wonder at a burning star, or trace them along the fraying capillary of a fleshy musa peel. "What do you see, my jewel?" but her little mind was already swaddled in the thing, and she would not say.

One sweltering evening, when Vesper sagged low in the sky and the Spindle coruscated to the melody of her light, Aphir brought home to his daughter the gift of a pearl-glass globe from the village of Aepsyonth. Aphir had ceded much to the camelfolk for possession of the globe: tungsten coins stamped with the visage of the Chrome King, eiderdowns quilted in his youth on the banks of the River Opal, and several bunches of the fruits musa picked at the heights of their ripenesses. So did his heart swell when he set the globe into his daughter's tiny hands, however, that those things seemed worth no more than the dust they would gather.

Aphir's daughter was mesmerized by the globe, and every morning at daybreak Aphir would peer through the half-dressed window to see her perched in the slim shade of a musa plant, wheeling the glass in her hands. Aphir would wonder upon the vistas she beheld in that aurora of ribboned glass, but hers was a world through which no ingress might see him, where perhaps she sailed tributaries to a sea of indigo under a chimeric sun. Yet Aphir was master to an ancient truth -- that to love a thing, you needn't understand it.

When the season of the scythe came, Aphir would wake each morning to an empty cottage, though he spared his daughter's absence no thought, for in those days children were wild, and free. At eventide his daughter would return to him. "Where do you go, my jewel? What do you see?" he would say, but she would only sit by his tired feet and weed loose threads from a dusty rug.

On the first night of the Ut yara Ux, Aphir's daughter did not come home. Aphir cried her name to the silhouette of the Spindle and the aphotic shades of the musa plants; he whispered it behind the grandfather clock and beneath her divan. But she gave no answer.

The next morning, he hiked the musa grove to the base of the lofty Spindle, and from there onward to Aepsyonth on the Yonth. But his daughter had not been espied in either of these ancient places. Aphir trekked forth, to the villages of Seept and Pansao and Yaat, and onward to the gates of the effluvial city of Mor. Aphir besieged the justiciar of that draconian precinct of state, but the sinecure spoke harshly and bid him depart the city. So Aphir returned to his cottage in the musa grove with a great melancholy taken residence in his heart.

All through the pungent Spring of the grove Aphir sat about in a gray haze. Many times a nearby starling struck a note that echoed his daughter's soft chortle, and his heart thrashed a beat in his chest before the birdsong flitted back to its emptiness of meaning. Eventually his sister came from Aepsyonth to live beside him and assuage his grief. She loved him, and brushed his hair, and kept the salt from his eyes. 

And so he sat through the high summer, and the next season of the scyth, and the season of the wind after that. At dusk his sister would lay an eiderdown over his legs to keep the chill from his bones, for even in the midst of a wind spell, he felt nothing through the thickness of the gray haze. But as the months marched by, and his sister read to him from the hoary tomes she brought from her wife's village, the light of the world began to shine through. In time Aphir would rise again, and split the musa peel, and taste the cloying air of the grove. And though the haze about him finally broke, he knew still his daughter would never return.

But Aphir did not believe her lost -- on sacred nights he would gaze over the Spindle, mantled in a thousand lights, and upon the field of burning stars. And he knew his jewel was among them, for she belonged not of his world, but of theirs.

Una noche sofocante, cuando el Vesper se hundía bajo en el cielo y el Spindle centelleaba al ritmo de su luz, Aphir llevó a casa para su hija el regalo de una esfera de vidrio perla desde el pueblo de Aepsyonth. Aphir había cedido mucho a los camelfolk por posesión de la esfera: monedas de tungsteno estampadas con la faz del Rey Cromo, mantas de edredón cosidas en su juventud junto

entries.source:
"Wait!" My muscles clenched as she paused, considering. I pressed on. "Answer me this, at least: why apple farmers?"

She laughed, the beautiful tinkling crystal blade of her voice slicing my heart to ribbons. The last thing I heard before my faint consciousness surrendered its grasp on my mind was her trailing reply, receding with distance.

"Why, it's because we love starapples!"
entries.translation:
"¡Espera!" Mis músculos se tensaron cuando ella se detuvo, considerando. Yo seguí adelante. "Respóndeme al menos esto: ¿por qué agricultores de manzanas?"

Ella rio, aquel hermoso y cristalino filo de su voz cortando mis entrañas en ribbons. Lo último que escuché antes de que mi débil conciencia soltara su agarre sobre mi mente fue su respuesta posterior, alejándose con la distancia.

"¡Porque amamos las manzanas estelares!"

entries.source:
She turned her head the barest degree toward mine. I still couldn't see her eyes. "Always," she replied, and I could hear the wry smirk in her voice.

"Does your father know you walk the orchard of a night?" I asked her.

"If you mean the apple farmer," she said, "he is not my father. We are family by choice. We always are, the farmers and the children."

I stared, gaping.

"I really ought not to have told you that," she continued, "but you seemed special, to resist the lure the way you're trying to do."

My jaw worked, but it took a few tries for my voice to catch up. "If what you say is true, then... what are you?" I managed at last.

"Already too candid." She kicked off the tree and landed gracefully with a flurry of her skirts. "I must take my leave."
entries.translation:
Ella giró su cabeza el más mínimo grado hacia la mía. Aún no podía ver sus ojos. —Siempre—, respondió, y pude percibir en su voz una sonrisa irónica.

—¿Lo sabe tu padre de que caminas por el huerto a la noche?— le pregunté.

—Si te refieres al agricultor de manzanas —dijo—, él no es mi padre. Somos familia por elección. Siempre lo hemos sido, los agricultores y los niños.

La miré, boquiabierto.

—Realmente no debería haberte dicho eso —continuó—, pero pareces especial, para resistir la tentación de la manera en que lo intentas.

Mi mandíbula se movió, pero tardé unos momentos en encontrar mi voz. —Si lo que dices es verdad —logré por fin—, ¿entonces... qué eres?

—Ya demasiado franca. —Ella se impulsó del árbol y aterrizó con gracia entre un remolino de sus faldas.— Debo tomar mi despedida.

{{y|She perched atop the branches of a blighted tree, staring up at the faint light of the spindle. When I spotted her, I caught myself mid-step, mid-breath, mid-thought. Have you ever known the misfortune of allowing your eyes to settle upon the divine vision of an apple farmer's daughter? If so, you understand how I felt in that moment.}}

Understand: I had done all I could, before now. I would have loved to stay elsewhere, but I'd traveled six parasangs with no rest, no discoveries but for a ruin occupied by an unfriendly cult. Too busy dodging arrows to ask about empty beds or compensation, I chose the apple farm instead. I took pains to avoid her when the salt sun shone, and so too did she avoid me, remaining a slight and swathed figure shying away in the periphery of my vision. I kept my focus on the farmer's craggy visage, on his wild and prominent whiskers, on his sweetly-rotting cider breath as we arranged the terms of my lodging.

It was not until the beetle moon passed overhead that I dared stand and wander, and it was then that I saw her, and the feeling of bone-deep infatuation at once seized me. I caught myself mid-step, mid-breath, mid-thought, and I stumbled onto a fallen twig. It snapped loudly. I stood still.

The beautiful creature atop the tree did not lift a finger or turn her head, but she did address me. "Moon and sun, traveler."

"Wisdom and will," I replied, gritting my teeth. It was a rare thing to hear the voice of an apple farmer's daughter, and it only seemed to increase the pressure on my racing hearts. I would not allow this all-encompassing feeling to overtake me. I longed for her to say something. I dreaded it.

A tense silence crawled by, until I gathered myself and broke it. "You're restless too?"

{{o|The Recitation of the Drowning of Eudoxia by the witches of Moonhearth, who seek the Plane of Sorrow}}
      
Once, in a dream the nine of us shared, we lived the life of a famous poet in the court of a gleaming city. From the windowed eye of a palace we'd gaze onto streets of gold and glass, and purple gardens, and the people of the city, suffused in the love of our work, would lay amaranths at the bronze feet of our likenesses, and remit blessings for the august and oracular Keskonda.

But we would draw the velvet curtain shut, and return to the ink oceans and paper isles that were our true domain. There, one unearthly night, we sat in the back-breaking clutch of an iron chair, and poured grief onto the page until it surpassed even our own, and, by following from its own internal logic, transmuted into something new.

When we woke, we wept for days. Then - speaking through hushed and love-soaked whispers - we reconstructed piece by piece the words of the verse we penned in the gleaming city.


    {{O|The Drowning of Eudoxia}}
      
    I saw a tern in the crest of an ocean wave. The sun was pulled apart by clouds, and the light was thin. Being a nimble girl of twelve, I scurried down the rampart and onto the salt-slick stone of the cliff;
    
    Hand-under-hand I descended into the raucous spray, turning on every twelfth to gaze at the white feathered speck swelling and sinking in the ocean's breath.
    
    I, an adept swimmer, sunk into the cold and endless bath, and arm-over-arm pulled both water and tern toward me.
    
    Just then my ears were drowned in a roar, and the world was suffused in darkness before shattering into light again. My nose was stinging; I wiped the water from my eyes and oriented myself toward the tern, whose tired body floated like leaves, and once again I pulled my astral tether.
    
    There was another roar and crash, and then the light returned again but more slowly this time, and my breath was sucked out of my tiny lungs;
    
    I spun my head around in search of the tern, but the water was gleaming and looked as though it held a thousand terns, or none.
    
    Another roar and crash, and I was engulfed in the dark realm for what felt like days, before my body was pressed back into the sun-world, spinning and doll-like.
    
    I gasped and whipped about. Far and away I glimpsed the bright stone of the castle, which may have been sand all along, now that it looked so small.
    
    The tide pulled me apart and threw the clouded aether between me, and I knew that I was dying.
    
    But just when my mind had spread open like a gas, a great swell of water thrust me to the surface, and reconstituted me in the bright realm. There I lived forever, before I sunk into a new and dark life.
    
    So it is still, that even after an eternity of hushed nothing a swell of pressure delivers me into brightness, whereby a strange and curious compulsion I draw a breath of sweetest life, before I'm again sublimated into extinction.
    
    Death is forever approached.

entries.source:
I remember. Once.

Watching over the firmament.

Standing. Between oblivion and wild growth. Guiding and guarding. The liminal spaces.

It may never have been so simple. But I bore weight more easily.

Once. Before my kin. Stole the firmament from me.

I was greater then. Perhaps I will be greater again.

With help. Someday.
entries.translation:
Lo recuerdo. Una vez.

Velando sobre el firmamento.

De pie. Entre la oblivión y el crecimiento desbocado. Guiando y protegiendo. Los espacios liminales.

Tal vez nunca haya sido tan sencillo. Pero llevé el peso con más facilidad.

Una vez. Antes de que mi kin me arrebataran el firmamento.

Fui mayor entonces. Quizás volveré a serlo.

Con ayuda. Algún día.

entries.source:
"Let the manes put off their terror, let them put off their aqueous bodies with fire.
      Let them draw together the bones of the metal.
      Selvaggia, Guiscarda, Mandetta,
      Rain flakes of gold on the water
      Azure and flaking silver of water,
      Pallor of silver, pale lustre of Latona,
      By these, from the malevolence of the dew
      Guard this alembic.
      Elain, Tireis, Allodetta
      Quiet this metal."
      -Ezra Pound
entries.translation:
Que los manes aparten su terror, que se despojen de sus cuerpos acuosos con fuego.  
Que reúnan los huesos del metal.  
Selvaggia, Guiscarda, Mandetta,  
Llovizón de oro sobre el agua,  
Azul y plata quebradiza del agua,  
Pálida blancura de la plata, pálido resplandor de Latona,  
Por estos, contra la maldad del rocío  
Guarda este alambique.  
Elain, Tireis, Allodetta,  
Calmad este metal.  
-Ezra Pound

Los hombros anchos y las trampas de =pronouns.Possessive= portan la huella distintiva de manejar el haz de soldadura y el egis, herramientas del oficio que doblan como armas sagradas.

Nails filth-black flash from out =pronouns.possessive= sleeve in a gesture-poem to say that plague is but transmutation, death is the ladder to life, and the existence of children proves the prelacy of raw growth. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= peppered with shale dust.

The rhythm of =pronouns.possessive= steps contain no pattern.

Las uñas, negras de inmundicia, centellan desde la manga =pronouns.possessive= en un gesto-poema para decir que la plaga no es sino transmutación, la muerte es la escalera hacia la vida, y la existencia de los niños prueba la primacía del crecimiento bruto. El ritmo de los pasos =pronouns.possessive= no contiene patrón alguno.

entries.source: A full-scale continental shelf of half-calcified, star-orchid body mass creeps over the earth, sending stone, chrome, wood, and brass to quivers. Hundreds of thousands of underspines convey =pronouns.possessive= quincunx of cyclopean arms into motion, and a delta of subducting stomach muscle sticks and subsumes matter into =pronouns.possessive= somatic star-bounds. In =pronouns.possessive= wake an arcology of disarranged world-fragments is raised.
entries.translation: Una plataforma continental de gran escala, compuesta por masa corporal de orquídea estelar medio calcificada, se extiende sobre la tierra, haciendo temblar piedra, cromo, madera y bronce. Cientos de miles de espinas inferiores transmiten =pronouns.possessive= quincunx de brazos ciclopianos en movimiento, y un delta de músculo estomacal que se subduce se adhiere y absorbe la materia en =pronouns.possessive= límites somáticos estelares. En el =pronouns.possessive= despliegue se eleva una arquitectura de fragmentos del mundo desordenados.

entries.source: A giant cone of calcereous shell conceals a softform body. It tilts to the side, and its many whorls are sequenced to impress the eye with pleasing geometry before swerving to uncomfortable and dizzying disharmony.
entries.translation: Un gigantesco cono de concha calcárea encierra un cuerpo de forma blanda. Se inclina hacia un lado, y sus múltiples espirales están dispuestas para deleitar la vista con una geometría agradable antes de desviarse hacia una desagradable y vertiginosa disonancia.

entries.source: A giant is carpentered from large-scale scrap towed from the trash sea. Tailstock legs meet a great flange torso at shimmed hips, piston arms break at wye pipe shoulders, and a bent pressing plate soldered with radio antennae delivers an empty stare.
entries.translation: Un gigante es carpentado a partir de chatarra de gran escala arrastrada desde el mar de basuras. Las piernas de cola de husillo se encuentran con un torso de gran flange en caderas ajustadas, los brazos de pistón se rompen en hombros de tubería en forma de Y, y una placa de prensión doblada soldada con antenas de radio entrega una mirada vacía.

entries.source: A giant mound of rotting iron flesh puts some elevation to the ground.
entries.translation: Una enorme montaña de carne de hierro en descomposición le da cierta elevación al suelo.

entries.source: A giant ribbon of scaleless tissue quivers in suspension beyond a mouth ringed with repeating triangle teeth, and imagined finnage dresses =pronouns.possessive= glistening length. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:extrude:afterpronoun= a double through the mirrored planes of reality, and inverts back through them to extrude a triple.
entries.translation: Una gigantesca cinta de tejido escamoso vibra en suspensión más allá de una boca rodeada de dientes triangulares repetidos, y la imaginada aleta cubre =pronouns.possessive= longitud resplandeciente. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:extrude:afterpronoun= un doble a través de los planos reflejados de la realidad, e invierte de regreso a través de ellos para extruir un triple.

entries.source: A giant, spotted keel pushes against =pronouns.possessive= acid-moist membrane. Burnt air puffs down the radula, and =pronouns.possessive= pores leak a digestive liquor.
entries.translation: Una gran quilla manchada empuja contra la membrana ácida-mojada de =pronouns.possessive=. El aire chamuscado se filtra por la radula, y los poros de =pronouns.possessive= gotean un líquido digestivo.

entries.source: A godsuit of chrome shines in the baptism bloodoil of the Great Cistern, where even standing at the lowest basin =pronouns.subjective= broke the cavern rafters. Uuflax braids cinctured with ties of offworld goldleaf spill from the crown radar and over =pronouns.possessive= deltoid chassis. Every piece of =pronouns.possessive= glass and chrome was sourced from the arcological heart, encased in resin, pullchained up and hotbrushed in the temple foundry. The entry hatch is hung with a sigil rug of the pilot, who climbed in to anchor here years ago and communes now with the Godhead.
entries.translation: Una armadura divina de cromo resplandece en la sangre aceitosa del bautismo de la Gran Cisterna, donde incluso estar de pie en el basamento más bajo =pronouns.subjective= rompió los techos de la caverna. Los trenzados de Uuflax, ceñidos con tiras de oro foliado extraterrestre, caen desde la corona radar y sobre =pronouns.possessive= el chasis deltoidal. Cada pieza de =pronouns.possessive= vidrio y cromo provino del corazón arquitectónico, envuelta en resina, elevada mediante cadena de tracción y pulida con cepillo caliente en la fragua del templo. La escotilla de entrada cuelga adornada con una alfombra con el emblema del piloto, quien entró hace años para anclarse aquí y ahora comunica con la Divinidad.

entries.source: A greasy sac of goo gyres over the floor in spiral-step. Under =pronouns.possessive= membrane, a shoal of spitbright eels slither for freedom.
entries.translation: Una bolsa grasa de baba gira sobre el suelo en paso espiral. Debajo de la membrana =pronouns.possessive=, un cardumen de peces espitbrillante reptan buscando libertad.

entries.source: A greasy sac of luminous broth gyres over the floor in spiral-step and lights a helical path.
entries.translation: Una bolsa grasienta de caldo luminoso gira sobre el suelo en paso espiral y enciende un camino helicoidal.

entries.source: A greebled egg of metal and circuited glass was fished from the chromefall to be welded on and serve as spiritual center mass for a minyan of woodsprogs. =pronouns.Possessive= sensory pane is fused at junction points to the selfsame mask of =pronouns.possessive= creator/minions, tied with ribbons of mossgrowth and wire.
entries.translation: Una huevo greebleado de metal y vidrio circuitado fue pescado del chromefall para soldarse y servir como masa espiritual central para un minyan de woodsprogs. =pronouns.Possessive= panel sensorial está fundido en puntos de unión a la misma máscara de =pronouns.possessive= creador/servidores, atada con ribbons de crecimiento de musgo y alambre.

entries.source: A hoary humanoid slumps beneath the weight of =pronouns.possessive= broad and cragged back. Soaking fibers of inky, unkempt hair enswathe the great pale shoulder-rocks, and crossed over =pronouns.possessive= wide chest are two carbide axes rotting with rust. Rumpled lids lay half-shut over the discs of =pronouns.possessive= sluggish eyes, glazed in the respite of a convalessence bath.
entries.translation: Un ser humanoide plateado se hunde bajo el peso de =pronouns.possessive= espalda amplia y rugosa. Fibra empapada, cabello inquieto y desaliñado envuelve las grandes rocas pálidas de los hombros, y sobre =pronouns.possessive= ancho pecho descansan dos hachas de carburo corroídas por la herrumbre. Párpados arrugados reposan medio cerrados sobre los discos de =pronouns.possessive= ojos

entries.source: A hominid-suit of chrome is junctured together from parts across the layer cake of time: balance struts hammered off the crushed star blimp, mainshaft springs torn from buoyed chapels, actuators hewed from the machine hearts of city centers, intakes blown of molten lamp glass. A proton rod capitals each shoulder, chipped to the Z radius in the mirrorshops of lower earth.
entries.translation: Una armadura homínida de cromo se articula juntamente desde partes a través del pastel estratificado del tiempo: soportes de equilibrio forjados de la nave aerostática aplastada por la estrella, resortes principales arrancados de capillas flotantes, actuadores tallados de los corazones mecánicos de centros urbanos, admisiones expulsadas de vidrio fundido de lámparas. Un bastón de protones corona cada hombro, tallado hasta el radio Z en los talleres de espejos de la tierra inferior.

entries.source: A hominid-suit of chrome is junctured together from parts across the layer cake of time: balance struts hammered off the crushed star blimp, mainshaft springs torn from buoyed chapels, actuators hewed from the machine hearts of city centers, intakes blown of molten lamp glass. One arm ends in a giant blade, machined to final form at the Eater presses that stamp out artworks in the forever mode.
entries.translation: Una armadura homínida de cromo se articula juntamente desde piezas a lo largo del pastel de capas del tiempo: balancines forjados de la globulosa aplastada de estrella, resortes principales arrancados de capillas sostenidas, actuadores tallados de los corazones mecánicos de centros urbanos, admisiones expulsadas de vidrio fundido de lámparas. Un brazo termina en una gran hoja, mecanizada a su forma definitiva en las prensas de los Devoradores que estampen obras en el modo eterno.

entries.source: A hood shades =pronouns.possessive= face from the salt sun and the halogen lamps of the vacated underearth. =pronouns.Possessive= cloak bulges around a scrapbag slung about =pronouns.possessive= waist, and =pronouns.possessive= core is tense with the promise of the chase.
entries.translation: Una capucha en sombra la cara de =pronouns.possessive= del sol salino y las lámparas halogenas del underearth vaciado. La capa de =pronouns.Possessive= se hincha alrededor de un saco de chatarra colgado sobre el vientre de =pronouns.possessive=, y el núcleo de =pronouns.possessive= está tenso con la promesa de la caza.

entries.source: A hot cage of thermonuclear torrent is trussed with semiconductors. There are indentations in the casing for assisted transport.
entries.translation: Una jaula ardiente de torrente termonuclear está atado con semiconductoras. Hay hendiduras en la carcasa para el transporte asistido.

entries.source: A lattice of frostknit swaddles =pronouns.possessive= coarse beard and bushy brow hair. The great, bony slab of =pronouns.possessive= head is wreathed in a crown of ice-breath, and =pronouns.possessive= arms, long and dwindled and dead-pale, are tattooed in patterns of twinkling filament.
entries.translation: Una red de hilos helados envuelve la barba áspera y el cabello abundante de =pronouns.possessive=. La gran placa ósea de =pronouns.possessive= cabeza está coronada por una corona de aliento glacial, y los brazos de =pronouns.possessive=, largos, encogidos y pálidos como la muerte, están tatuados con patrones de hilos centelleantes.

entries.source: A leaf disc gleams through luminous veins, flashing neon in advertisement. Arrayed across =pronouns.possessive= damp pad is a trove of wares.
entries.translation: Una lámina foliar resplandece a través de venas luminosas, parpadeando en neón como anuncio. Diseminados sobre =pronouns.possessive= almohadilla húmeda se halla un tesoro de mercancías.

entries.source: A leaf disc gleams through luminous veins.
entries.translation: Una hoja discoidal resplandece a través de venas luminosas.

entries.source: A lens of glass has crusted over the smooth stone where the heat of sacred math burned the air then cooled in Q.E.D. Under that dermis and the meteoritic layer, an electric heart grinds on the field of magnets at the earth's core and radiates a shower of sparks.
entries.translation: Una lente de vidrio ha cristalizado sobre la piedra pulida donde el calor del sagrado matemático quemó el aire y luego se enfrió en Q.E.D. Debajo de esa dermis y de la capa meteorítica, un corazón eléctrico se desgasta sobre el campo magnético en el núcleo terrestre y emana una lluvia de chispas.

entries.source: A lens of glass has crusted over the smooth stone where the heat of sacred math burned the air then cooled in Q.E.D. Under that dermis and the meteoritic layer, an electric heart grinds on the field of magnets at the earth's core and radiates a shower of sparks. This one emits a chromesoft purr.
entries.translation: Una lente de vidrio ha endurecido sobre la piedra pulida donde el calor del matemático sagrado quemó el aire y luego se enfrió en Q.E.D. Debajo de esa dermis y de la capa meteorítica, un corazón eléctrico se desgasta en el campo magnético en el núcleo de la tierra y emana una lluvia de chispas. Esta emite un ronroneo de cromo suave.

entries.source: A long and split tail feather drapes below =pronouns.possessive= talons at an immaterial buoyancy. =pronouns.Possessive= epaulets are incandescent and =pronouns.possessive= frill is a vane for astral weather.
entries.translation: Una larga pluma dividida cuelga bajo las garras de =pronouns.possessive= con una flotación inmaterial. Las mangas de =pronouns.Possessive= son incandescentes y la =pronouns.possessive= cresta es una vane para el clima astral.

entries.source: A man in the threadbare clothes of a tattered knight stands as if hewn from the trunk of a tree. Gnarled hands grip with more force than is needed for the task of standing at an unasked vigil.
entries.translation: Un hombre vestido con las andrajosas prendas de un caballero desgastado se encuentra de pie como si estuviera tallado en el tronco de un árbol. Manos retorcidas sostienen con más fuerza de la necesaria para cumplir la tarea de permanecer en una vigilancia no solicitada.

entries.source: A mane courses over =pronouns.possessive= large and sloping beast shoulders and spends its weight in auburn locks. =pronouns.Possessive= bone and velvet antlers fork into fractals.
entries.translation: Un pelaje corre sobre las amplias y pendientes espaldas de =pronouns.possessive= bestia, depositando su peso en trenzas castañas. Los cuernos de hueso y terciopelo de =pronouns.Possessive= se dividen en fractales.

entries.source: A mess of burnt hair drapes the jowls of a snarling mean mastiff, and two lengths of sharp canine bone drip =pronouns.possessive= bleaching saliva.
entries.translation: Un desorden de cabello chamuscado cuelga sobre las mejillas de un mastín rugiente y cruel, y dos trozos afilados de hueso canino gotean =pronouns.possessive= saliva blanquecina.

entries.source: A million etches across the parted leaf-chime speak the sense of touch. A sap-like substance drips off the crystal tip and attenuates =pronouns.possessive= vibrations to the bass range.
entries.translation: Un millón de grabados a lo largo del campanillo de hojas separadas expresa el sentido del tacto. Una sustancia similar a la savia gotea de la punta cristalina y atenúa las vibraciones de =pronouns.possessive= hasta el rango grave.

entries.source: A monstrous shelf of sunless ivory upheaves on pointed legs. =pronouns.Possessive= eyesstalks are stalagmite husks -- only moss grows there now -- and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:wield:afterpronoun= a claw monolith that cuts stone like dry grass.
entries.translation: Una inmensa estantería de marfil sin sol se alza sobre patas afiladas. =pronouns.Possessive= ojos-palos son cáscaras de estalactita — solo el musgo crece allí ahora — y =pronouns.subjective= =verb:wield:afterpronoun= una monolítica garra que corta la piedra como la hierba seca.

entries.source: A monstrous, unlidded eye is perched on three spider-thin legs. Its lens is a lune of hot tetraxenonoglass, its iris a supernova of gallium circuitry. All the honey-thick light that pours through the void of its pupil is pumped up the arterial turnpike, drank by the optic nerve, and dripped like dye into the grayscale field of its dreaming brain.
entries.translation: Una inmensa y sin párpado ojo reposa sobre tres patas delgadas como las de una araña. Su lente es un cuarto de vidrio de tetraxenón caliente, su pupila una supernova de circuitos de galio. Todo el luz espesa que fluye a través del vacío de su iris se bombea por la arteria autopista, absorbida por el nervio óptico y derramada como tinta en el campo en escala de grises de su cerebro soñador.

entries.source: A mortar tube enameled with fire blister bounces on a gyroscopic mount between a pair of chrome-hooved kickers.
entries.translation: Un tubo de mortero enlazado con ampollas de fuego rebota sobre un soporte giratorio entre un par de impulsadores con cascos de cromo.

entries.source: A mound of scorched hair and rotting flesh puts some elevation to the ground.
entries.translation: Una montaña de cabello carbonizado y carne en descomposición eleva ligeramente el suelo.

entries.source: A mound of wet fur and rotting flesh puts some elevation to the ground.
entries.translation: Una colina de pelaje mojado y carne en descomposición añade algo de elevación al suelo.

entries.source: A mound of wet hair and rotting flesh puts some elevation to the ground. A single chipped horn curls out of the mess like a fungus sprout.
entries.translation: Una montaña de cabello húmedo y carne en descomposición le da cierta elevación al suelo. Un solo cuerno astillado se enrolla hacia afuera del revoltijo, como un brote fúngico.

entries.source: A mound of wet leaves, rootbind, and rotting flesh puts some elevation to the ground.
entries.translation: Una montaña de hojas mojadas, raíces enredadas y carne en descomposición le da cierta elevación al terreno.

entries.source: A mound of wet scales lay in a wreath of bloated death.
entries.translation: Una montaña de escamas húmedas yace en un círculo de muerte hinchada.

entries.source: A pair of calcified pokers were whetted by lineage to puncture the layer cake of skin.
entries.translation: Una pareja de palos calcificados fueron afilados por la linaje para perforar el pastel de capas de piel.

entries.source: A pair of calcified pokers were whetted by lineage to puncture the layer cake of skin. They're slick with a film of bubbling death sludge.
entries.translation: Una pareja de palos calcificados estaban afilados por la linaje para perforar la torta estratificada de piel. Están resbaladizos con una capa de lodo mortífero burbujeante.

entries.source: A pair of calcified pokers were whetted by lineage to puncture the layer cake of skin. They're slick with a film of condensed dream gas.
entries.translation: Una pareja de palos calcificados fueron afilados por la linaje para perforar el pastel de piel. Están resbaladizos con una película de gas onírico condensado.

entries.source: A pair of calcified pokers were whetted by lineage to puncture the layer cake of skin. They're slick with a film of condensed star gas.

entries.source: A pair of spitdrool snouts snap at each other's hairy ear. =pronouns.Possessive= hocks are widened to bear more weight than =pronouns.possessive= one-headed cousins, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:squeal:afterpronoun= with the choler of a twice-hungry animal.

Las =pronouns.Possessive= patas traseras están ensanchadas para soportar más peso que las =pronouns.possessive= primas de una sola cabeza, y =pronouns.subjective= =verb:squeal:afterpronoun= con la ira de un animal doblemente hambriento.

entries.source: A plume of smoke curls off the blackened snout-nostrils of the rotund pig. =pronouns.Possessive= ear hair is singed from =pronouns.possessive= nasal blazes.

entries.source: A powdery kittel curtains =pronouns.possessive= thin shoulders, whose relative bulk along with  the keenness of =pronouns.possessive= eye marks =pronouns.objective= as attentive to this timeplace, and so lower rank than =pronouns.possessive= seeker-kith.

entries.source: A proud and parted mane of bristles frames a wide grin. Tied with thread to several of them are thumb-bells meant to draw the attention of customers.
entries.translation: Una melena orgullosa y separada de púas enmarca una amplia sonrisa. Atadas con hilo a varias de ellas están campanillas de dedo destinadas a llamar la atención de los clientes.

entries.source: A quad of machine presses were ripped from the vaulted roofs of their underearth mills and welded to the casket of an earth-mover. Two  antennae touch the ever-stream of data in the dead air, and a spray of red light widens out a half-lidded eye.
entries.translation: Una cuadrilla de prensas mecánicas fue arrancada de los techados techo de sus molinos subterráneos y soldada al féretro de una máquina excavadora. Dos antenas tocan el flujo incesante de datos en el aire muerto, y un chorro de luz roja se expande en un ojo medio cerrado.

entries.source: A rain of gorgeous dust drifts down a frustum of light, and radiant mirrorwings bat it through the air vacuum.
entries.translation: Una lluvia de polvo hermoso desciende a través de un tronco de luz, y alas espejadas radiantes lo batuelan en el vacío del aire.

entries.source: A resin-cased knot of eggs joggle in place. Burning eyes peer out of the membrane.
entries.translation: Un nudo de huevos en una cáscara de resina se agita en su lugar. Ojos ardientes observan desde la membrana.

entries.source: A ribbon of scaleless tissue quivers in suspension beyond a mouth ringed with repeating triangle teeth. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:extrude:afterpronoun= a double through the mirrored planes of reality.
entries.translation: Una tira de tejido escamoso sin escamas tiembla en suspensión más allá de una boca rodeada por dientes triangulares repetidos. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:extrude:afterpronoun= se atraviesa dos veces a través de los planos reflejados de la realidad.

entries.source: A ribbon of sparkflow writhes between the slick feelers of a boulder-height snail. =pronouns.Possessive= muscular foot tenses in the static air and disappears beneath a striated shell.
entries.translation: Un ribete de chispa se retuerce entre los sensibles tentáculos de un caracol de la altura de una roca. =pronouns.Possessive= pie muscular se tensa en el aire estático y desaparece bajo una concha estratificada.

entries.source: A saddleface of scrutable metal material displays pictographs of healing and transformation. It swivels on a shackle that bifurcates to two chrome arms, each sporting a quickshot hand of booster-grooved digits.
entries.translation: Una cara de silla de material metálico inescrutable muestra pictogramas de sanación y transformación. Se balancea sobre una argolla que se divide en dos brazos cromados, cada uno portando una mano rápida con dedos surtidos de canales de propulsión.

entries.source: A severe hindren =pronouns.personTerm= =verb:wear:afterpronoun= a spotless white tabard with long tails tailored to drape across =pronouns.possessive= longish back. Dappled flanks are arrayed in saddlebags heavy with esoteric gadgetry, and a bluish-white crust grows across =pronouns.possessive= face, rendering =pronouns.possessive= gimlet stare all the more striking.
entries.translation: Una severa hindren =pronouns.personTerm= =verb:wear:afterpronoun= una túnica blanca impecable con largos extremos ajustados para caer sobre =pronouns.possessive= espalda algo prolongada. Las flancas manchadas están ordenadas en alforjas pesadas de artificios eruditos, y una costra azulada crece sobre =pronouns.possessive= rostro, haciendo que =pronouns.possessive= mirada aguja sea aún más llamativa.

entries.source: A shadow inches over the dull white carapace of a giant and caveborn crustacean. =pronouns.Possessive= eyestalks have shrunk to nothing in the sundim grottos of the underearth.
entries.translation: Una sombra se desliza sobre la opaca y blanca caparazón de un crustáceo gigante nacido en las cavernas. Las =pronouns.Possessive= antenas oculares han menguado hasta desaparecer en las grottas de sundim del subterráneo.

entries.source: A shoot-foot rhizome pod jitters on the dirt and sheds its brittle out-material. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:seek:afterpronoun= a hot vessel to deliver =pronouns.possessive= explosive gift.
entries.translation: Un pod de rizoma con pie de brote tiembla sobre el suelo y

entries.source: A slender figure is apparelled in wispy chrome beaten by hammer and vice to appear as bunched fabric and approximate the body politic. =pronouns.Possessive= faceplate is stamped with a neutral visage.
entries.translation: Una figura delgada está vestida con hilos finos de cromo golpeados por martillo y torno para parecer tela amontonada y aproximarse al cuerpo político. =pronouns.Possessive= placa facial está estampada con una cara neutral.

entries.source: A slight and trim faundren narrows =pronouns.possessive= Spindle-blue eyes. Like the other younglings, =pronouns.possessive= face is bright with burning curiosity. Unlike theirs, though, =pronouns.possessive= is tempered by poise and honed to a dagger's point by a startlingly precocious discipline.
entries.translation: Una faundren delgada y esbelta estrecha =pronouns.possessive= ojos de color Spindle-azul. Al igual que los otros jóvenes, =pronouns.possessive= rostro brilla con una curiosidad ardiendo. A diferencia de ellos, sin embargo, =pronouns.possessive= está templado por la elegancia y afilado hasta el punto de una daga por una disciplina asombrosamente precoz.

entries.source: A slime-moated egg with hairline cracks.
entries.translation: Un huevo rodeado de slime, con grietas finísimas.

entries.source: A slug has grown too large for =pronouns.possessive= anatomy to know what to do. Bubbles of stinking broth pop over breathing pores the size of elbows, and a fifth phase of trashlike matter leaks out =pronouns.possessive= crusty mantle and down the sharp keel of =pronouns.possessive= back. Where nature had the decency to end the body of the common slug in a muscular foot, Slog's tail is instead a sphincter-choked bilge hose that =pronouns.subjective= =verb:use:afterpronoun= to spew foul waterfunk about =pronouns.possessive= surroundings.
entries.translation: Una babosa ha crecido demasiado para que la anatomía de =pronouns.possessive= sepa qué hacer. Burbujas de caldo hediondo estallan sobre poros respiratorios del tamaño de codos, y una quinta fase de materia desagradable escapa por la crustosa manta de =pronouns.possessive= y por el afilado costillar de la espalda de =pronouns.possessive=. Donde la naturaleza tuvo el decoro de terminar el cuerpo de la babosa común en un pie muscular, la cola de Slog es en cambio una tubería de bilge cerrada por un esfínter que =pronouns.subjective= =verb:use:afterpronoun= para expulsar agua hedionda alrededor de =pronouns.possessive= entorno.

entries.source: A snow white slumping head is beset with keen and soft red eyes. =pronouns.Possessive= fur is powdery on =pronouns.possessive= hulking ape-frame, and on moon time instinct squeezes =pronouns.possessive= fist into a chest-beater.
entries.translation: Una cabeza blanca como la nieve, caída, está rodeada por ojos rojos afilados y suaves. =pronouns.Possessive= pelaje es polvoriento sobre =pronouns.possessive= enjuto cuerpo de hombre simio, y en el instante lunar aprieta =pronouns.possessive= puño en un golpe al pecho.

entries.source: A soaking span of soft tissue anneals to the floor. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:crumple:afterpronoun= with hot life.
entries.translation: Una prolongada extensión de tejido suave se adhiere al suelo. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:crumple:afterpronoun= con vida ardiente.

entries.source: A starshape of sheer and gummy tentacle shivers at the zero point. When =pronouns.subjective= =verb:sense:afterpronoun= something nearby, electric current charges a scale of mirror photons to replicate the image.
entries.translation: Una estrella de tentáculos pura y pegajosa tiembla en el punto cero. Cuando =pronouns.subjective= =verb:sense:afterpronoun= algo cercano, una corriente eléctrica carga una escala de fotones espejados para replicar la imagen.

entries.source: A steel-thick jacket of bullet-scarred collagen trusses the enormous shoulders and rump of the stamping beast, and a single, giant skull encases a trio of heads under a series of parietal plates that crest like ocean waves. Out of each, a saber of razor keratin curls roofward.
entries.translation: Una capa gruesa como el acero de colágeno lleno de marcas de balas abraza las inmensas espaldas y nalgas del bestia que estampa, y una sola cabeza gigantesca encierra un trío de cabezas bajo una serie de placas parietales que se elevan como olas del océano. Desde cada una, una espada de queratina afilada se enrolla hacia el techo.

entries.source: A stygian spongeball is stuck to the floor and dappled with disorienting dew.
entries.translation: Una esponjilla estigia permanece adherida al suelo y está salpicada de rocío desorientador.

entries.source: A stygian spongeball is stuck to the floor and dappled with dream dew.
entries.translation: Una esponja bola estigia está adherida al suelo y salpicada con rocío onírico.

entries.source: A telescopic monocle is affixed to =pronouns.possessive= eye, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:squint:afterpronoun= permanently. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:twirl:afterpronoun= a delicate stone in appraisal.
entries.translation: Un monocular telescópico está fijado en el ojo de =pronouns.possessive=, y =pronouns.subjective= =verb:squint:afterpronoun= permanece así permanentemente. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:twirl:afterpronoun= examina una piedra delicada.

entries.source: A ternion of transformations are given sharp shape against the fuzzy physics of earth-time. The triangle is inert and of an algebraic substance, but stillness slides off =pronouns.possessive= colorless arms; objects around =pronouns.objective= are forced into sets unfamiliar.
entries.translation: Una ternión de transformaciones toma forma afilada contra la física difusa del tiempo terrenal. El triángulo es inerte y de sustancia algebraica, pero el reposo se desliza por los brazos coloridos =pronouns.possessive= sin tonalidad; los objetos alrededor de =pronouns.objective= son forzados a conjuntos desconocidos.

entries.source: A thick cord of bristly segments are capped by a cuspate beak for breaking through shale.
entries.translation: Un grueso cordón de segmentos eriçados está coronado por un pico afilado para romper la arcilla.

entries.source: A thousand echo-worlds are scattered across the ground.
entries.translation: Mil mundos eco se hallan dispersos sobre el suelo.

entries.source: A toga wraps =pronouns.possessive= hulking, bright-fur frame, and a broad brim shades =pronouns.possessive= wise and wideset eyes. A sedentary life has sapped some of =pronouns.possessive= ape strength: burly shoulders slouch their weight onto a walking stick, a belly swells the linen around =pronouns.possessive= waist, and plump, sloping cheeks rim a warm and welcoming grin.
entries.translation: Una toga envuelve el robusto y peludo cuerpo de =pronouns.possessive=, y un amplio ala sombrea los sabios y anchos ojos de =pronouns.possessive=. Una vida sedentaria ha mermado algo de la fuerza simiesca de =pronouns.possessive=: hombros fornidos cargan su peso sobre un bastón, un vientre hincha el lino alrededor del cinturón de =pronouns.possessive=, y mejillas redondas y aplanadas marcan una sonrisa cálida y acogedora.

entries.source: A torn kufiya has been cut and resewn to a cowl, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:have:afterpronoun= tailored a knapsack to approximate the slate habit of the chromaic people. A human bone sheathed in copper wire is slung on =pronouns.possessive= hip, and =pronouns.subjective= =verb:rub:afterpronoun= a salt-nailed thumb over a talisman of cracked circuitboard.
entries.translation: Una kufiya desgarrada ha sido cortada y reprendida para convertirse en un capuz, y =pronouns.subjective= =verb:have:afterpronoun= ajustó una mochila para imitar el hábito de placas del pueblo cromático. Un hueso humano envainado en alambre de cobre está colgado en el =pronouns.possessive= muslo, y =pronouns.subjective= =verb:rub:afterpronoun= muestra un dedo salado sobre un amuleto de tablero de circuitos agrietado.

entries.source: A troika of monstrous, gleaming wheels orbit a center sphere of xenon clouds and gallium lightning. The spokes are laminated crysteel bled of their emerald imperfections, and the rims are milky epithelium -- a single iris stretched to the topology of a torus -- and checkered on the underside with pupils. =pronouns.Possessive= movement traces the carpentry of worlds.
entries.translation: Una troika de ruedas monstruosas y resplandecientes orbita una esfera central compuesta de nubes de xenón y relámpagos de galio. Los radios están laminados con crysteel despojado de sus imperfecciones esmeraldas, y los aros son epitelio lechoso —una sola pupila estirada según la topología de un toro— y en su cara inferior están rayados con pupilas en cuadriculado. =pronouns.Possessive= el movimiento traza la carpintería de mundos.

entries.source: A warm smile spreads over an old face freckled by time and a million crumbs of salt. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:shrink:afterpronoun= under a hunched back and =verb:drum:afterpronoun= the ground beneath =pronouns.objective= with a short and barb-crowned tail. A second pair of arms rise over the slump of =pronouns.possessive= shoulders, where hands meet and fingers lace to form another face, this one vacant and prehistoric, no mouth and eyes desert-white.
entries.translation: Una cálida sonrisa se extiende sobre una antigua cara manchada por el tiempo y un millón de migajas de sal. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:shrink:afterpronoun= bajo una espalda encorvada y =verb:drum:afterpronoun= el suelo bajo =pronouns.objective= con una cola corta y coronada de espinas. Un segundo par de brazos se eleva sobre el hombro caído de =pronouns.possessive=, donde las manos se encuentran y los dedos enlazan para formar otra cara, esta vacía y prehistórica, sin boca ni ojos blanquísimos como el desierto.

entries.source: A weapon is mounted on the splayed legs of an automated tripod.
entries.translation: Una arma está montada sobre las piernas abiertas de un trípode automatizado.

entries.source: A white shape slumps like a deserted hill-city. Its purple pennants are still.
entries.translation: Una figura blanca se hunde como una ciudad-hill abandonada. Sus estandartes púrpura permanecen inmóviles.

entries.source: A whole man is formed of skinstuff that mirrors the subsurface scattering and rivulet imperfections of sculpted marble. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= white and pink and blushing with the sanguinity of moonlight filtered through a sieve of monofilament chrome. Eyes drawn to a lasting point, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:cast:afterpronoun= a furious gaze on a world made defamiliar.
entries.translation: Un hombre entero está formado de skinstuff que refleja la dispersión subsuperficial y las imperfecciones de riachuelos de mármol tallado. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= blanco, rosa y ruborizado con la sanguinidad de la luz de luna filtrada a través de una criba de cromo monofilamento. Ojos dirigidos a un punto perdurable, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:cast:afterpronoun= una mirada airada sobre un mundo hechizado de extrañeza.

entries.source: Ageless little eyes on stalks stick out of an elfin shell whose geometry conforms curiously to the shape of chutes and vents, Eater-wrought and after.
entries.translation: Pequeños ojos inmunes al paso del tiempo, montados sobre tallos, sobresalen de una concha elfina cuya geometría se acomoda curiosamente a la forma de conductos y ventilaciones, talladas por los Devoradores y posteriores.

entries.source: All lithe muscle and hard vigilance, Neelahind =verb:become= =pronouns.possessive= occupation as the warden of Bey Lah. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:bloom:afterpronoun= to fill the faulds of =pronouns.possessive= armor, but the attentive eye that matches hers catches sight of a secret truth: inside the stout and sturdy body of the warrior hides a scared and flustered faundren.
entries.translation: Todo músculo ágil y vigilancia incansable, Neelahind =verb:become= =pronouns.possessive= desempeñaba la función de guardiana de Bey Lah. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:bloom:afterpronoun= para llenar las faldillas del armadura de =pronouns.possessive=, pero el ojo atento que corresponde al suyo advierte una verdad oculta: dentro del cuerpo robusto y firme de la guerrera se esconde un faundren asustado y acelerado.

entries.source: An avalanche of salt off a pretender dune reveals something out of the late world's aching dream: a living iodine grotto, nurtured to =pronouns.possessive= implausible size by the vast and buoyant waveplain of Moghra'yi. A rain curtain of glass streams across the inflow of =pronouns.possessive= filter feed, and behind, the ingested planet is laid in pulverized tracts.
entries.translation: Una avalancha de sal desde una duna de pretensión revela algo surgido del doloroso sueño del mundo tardío: una grotta viva de yodo, nutrida hasta =pronouns.possessive= tamaño improbable por la inmensa y flotante llanura ondulada de Moghra'yi. Una cortina de lluvia de vidrio cruza el afloramiento de =pronouns.possessive= alimentación filtrante, y detrás, el planeta ingerido se extiende en trazos pulverizados.

entries.source: Anchor shanks wet with a nameless slick do a stubborn glomming onto the ground. A saucer rife with nubs bends upward, and sitting inside it, a steamy globe gurgles sounds of the other-world. There are processes at work on those moist and inner clouds, but their rules are locked beyond knowledge.
entries.translation: Los talones de ancla, mojados con una sustancia sin nombre, se aferran obstinadamente al suelo. Un platillo lleno de protuberancias se inclina hacia arriba, y sentado dentro de él, una bola húmeda burbujea con sonidos del otro mundo. Hay procesos en funcionamiento sobre esas nubes húmedas e internas, pero sus reglas están cerradas más allá del conocimiento.

entries.source: Anxiety personified, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:stand:afterpronoun= in poised tension, =pronouns.possessive= shanks taut and =pronouns.possessive= long ears twitching. Narrow eyes dart hither and yon in search of intruders. Here in the body of the scout, the high nerves of the hindren farmers are heightened to a pitch.
entries.translation: La ansiedad encarnada, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:stand:afterpronoun= en tensión contenida, =pronouns.possessive= muslos rígidos y =pronouns.possessive= largas orejas temblorosas. Ojos estrechos que se desvían de un lado a otro en busca de intrusos. Aquí, dentro del cuerpo del explorador, los nervios elevados de los agricultores hindren están exaltados al extremo.

entries.source: Anxious legs, grown longer in the vacated space around =pronouns.objective=, ply the mineral dirt. A drop of gastric flux sloshes inside =pronouns.possessive= stomach-orb, powering =pronouns.possessive= instinctual rotation of the local ley.
entries.translation: Piernas inquietas, alargadas en el espacio vacío alrededor de =pronouns.objective=, recorren la tierra mineral. Una gota de flujo gástrico se balancea dentro del órgano estomacal de =pronouns.possessive=, alimentando la rotación instintiva local de la ley.

entries.source: Arches of burnished shell huddle together as a shy metal pill bug. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:inch:afterpronoun= along on brush-shaped appendages, and the only way to tell for sure which way =pronouns.subjective= =verb:face:afterpronoun= is the cross of light athwart =pronouns.possessive= front plate.
entries.translation: Arco de conchas pulidas se agrupan como un caracol metálico tímido. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:inch:afterpronoun= avanzan sobre apéndices en forma de cepillo, y la única manera de determinar con certeza hacia dónde =pronouns.subjective= =verb:face:afterpronoun= es la cruz de luz que cruza =pronouns.possessive= placa frontal.

entries.source: Asphodel (called the Lovely) =subject.verb:turn= =pronouns.possessive= tipping anthers at seductive angles. All the bright golds of the harvest sun and musa peel are garnishes to the frail beauty of =pronouns.possessive= petal. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:claim:afterpronoun= the aesthetic lineage of Hegelrut, and from that argument flowers =pronouns.possessive= claim to Omonporch and the entire Great Shade of the grove.
entries.translation: Asfodel (llamado el Bellísimo) =subject.verb:turn= =pronouns.possessive= inclinando anteras en ángulos seductores. Todos los brillantes amarillos del sol de la cosecha y la cáscara de musa son adornos a la frágil belleza de la pétala de =pronouns.possessive=. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:claim:afterpronoun= la linaje estético de Hegelrut, y de ese argumento florecen =pronouns.possessive= reclamando a Omonporch y toda la Gran Sombra del bosque.

entries.source: At a register under the falsetto chiming of =pronouns.possessive= choralers, the priest intones verses from the Canticles Chromaic. Arm gestures of emphasis blow the sleeves of =pronouns.possessive= robe out to great sails, swelling on the ecstatic air.
entries.translation: A un registro bajo el falso repique de =pronouns.possessive= corales, el sacerdote entona versos de los Cantares Cromáticos. Los gestos de brazos para enfatizar hacen que las mangas de la túnica de =pronouns.possessive= se expandan como grandes velas, inflándose con el aire éxtasis.

entries.source: Auric gills tense and release, tense and release, tense and release, as if drawing breath into the puffer's stem. With each exhalation it belches a cloud of golden spores like motes of sunlight. They flutter back to the cap and congeal into a golden plasma.
entries.translation: Las branquias auricas se tensan y sueltan, se tensan y sueltan, se tensan y sueltan, como si aspiraran aire hacia el tallo del inflador. Con cada exhalación, escupe una nube de esporas doradas como partículas de luz solar. Ellas revolotean de regreso al sombrero y se solidifican en un plasma dorado.

entries.source: Azure gills tense and release, tense and release, tense and release, as if drawing breath into the puffer's stem. With each exhalation it belches a cloud of indigo spores like motes of twilight. They flutter back to the cap and congeal into an azure plasma.

entries.source: Geometry is stressed under the gelatin alp, which erupts from the smooth planes of its surroundings in disgusting triumph of size. Its k membranous faces, once taut by the pressurization of symmetry, now follow a sagging curve toward the wet core, and through the blurry placentae shines a museum of historical objects from across the numbered ages. Are those the bones of a pig? Is that a bronze bell? Inside the bright-slick sac, earth-remnants from across time are joined to one space, and k-Goninon sloshes in hunger.
entries.translation: La geometría se impone bajo el alp gelatinoso, que brota de las superficies lisas de su entorno en un desagradable triunfo del tamaño. Sus k caras membranosas, antes tensas por la presión de la simetría, ahora siguen una curva caída hacia el núcleo húmedo, y a través de las placentas borrosas brilla un museo de objetos históricos provenientes de todas las edades numeradas. ¿Serán esos los huesos de un cerdo? ¿Ese será un campanón de bronce? Dentro de la bolsa brillante y resbaladiza, restos terrenales de distintas épocas se unen en un solo espacio, y el k-Goninon se remueve con hambre.

entries.source: Heat, pressure, beauty, and transformation are concepts understood by every manner of human being. When the sundry tribes commune by campfire and the hillfolk aver the godliness of the mountain face, so does the troglodyte speak with wonderment of the splayed crystal-things that glint in the shadows of her cave. Though neither has the language to articulate the mechanisms that connect them, together they know these things are the same.
entries.translation: El calor, la presión, la belleza y la transformación son conceptos entendidos por toda suerte de seres humanos. Cuando las diversas tribus se reúnen alrededor del fuego de campamento y los moradores de las colinas afirman la divinidad de la cara de la montaña, así también habla el troglodita con asombro de aquellas cosas cristalinas extendidas que centellean en las sombras de su cueva. Aunque ninguno posee el lenguaje para articular los mecanismos que les unen, juntos conocen que estas cosas son la misma cosa.

entries.source: Here an ossified world-shell gives shade to the hot puffing life of the overearth. Yeast colonizes the lip of its cloud-spanning rim and sizzles.

entries.source: Humors are the eroded bits of the earth: dust flaked off a million-year-old wall of shale, runoff brine dripped through a hairline crack of chrome, dew clung to the lips of a pipe after it's belched its septic vapor. Under the right conditions, at time scales inscrutable to kith and kin, the bits are heaped together by the geometry of entropy and remorphed into the prime material anew.
entries.translation: Los humores son los fragmentos erosionados de la tierra: polvo que se desprendió de una pared de esquisto de un millón de años, salmuera de escorrentía que goteó a través de una grieta fina de cromo, rocío adherido a los labios de una tubería tras expulsar su vapor septico. Bajo las condiciones adecuadas, en escalas temporales incomprensibles para la kin y la kith, los fragmentos son amontonados por la geometría de la entropía y remoldados nuevamente en el material primigenio.

entries.source:
I met a cadre of mopango folk,
who told me tales of an ancient oak,
who stood and ruled for a century.
She towered tall over those below.
She cast shade down so they wouldn't grow,
but they all believed it was meant to be.

But when hot sky-fire broke tradition,
she found herself in no position,
To draw up any new decree.

-- Willow Shakesprig's 'Macoun', Act V, scene iii
entries.translation:
Encontré a una cohorte de gentes mopango,
que me contaron historias de un antiguo roble,
que se alzó y gobernó durante un siglo.
Ella se erguía alta sobre los que estaban debajo.
Proyectaba sombra para que no crecieran,
pero todos creyeron que así había de ser.

Pero cuando el fuego del cielo ardiente rompió la tradición,
ella se encontró en una posición desesperada,
Para elaborar algún nuevo decreto.

— Willow Shakesprig, 'Macoun', Acto V, escena iii

entries.source: Ideas like the tetravalence of carbon and silicon were suffocated in the thick valley air of jungle hamlets. The human gatherer who mounts a root-braided hillock and looks out to the horizon in wonder, who descries flecks of granite stirring on the mountain face, and who with ancestral dread ponders what toll the rocks themselves are animated to collect, he can't know the miracles of chemistry that sophists inscribed in data disks at the Long Before. Those miracles are to him the ciphers of god-things.
entries.translation: Ideas como la tetravalencia del carbono y el silicio fueron sofocadas en el denso aire de las valles junglales. El recolector humano que sube a una colina entrelazada de raíces y mira al horizonte con asombro, quien percibe destellos de granito moviéndose en la cara de la montaña, y quien medita con temor ancestral sobre qué tributo exigen las piedras mismas, no puede conocer los milagros de la química que sofistas inscribieron en discos de datos en la Longitud Antes. A esos milagros le ve él como cifras de cosas divinas.

entries.source: In its infancy, rock streamed through the planet in plumes of magma, spilled into hushed caverns, and quickened pools of protoplasm out of its stilled inertia. Plates slipped and matter was crushed, pressurized. Later, as entropy bore cracks into the crust, sticky lifethings fused to the rock and scuttled forth. In geological terms they are tiny things, but you insist that scale is the wrong one.
entries.translation: En su infancia, la roca fluía a través del planeta en chorros de magma, vertiéndose en cavernas silenciosas y animando con vida los estanques de protoplasma sacados de su inerte letargo. Las placas se deslizaron y la materia fue comprimida, sometida a presión. Más tarde, cuando la entropía abrió grietas en la corteza, cosas vivas pegajosas se fusionaron con la roca y se arrastraron hacia adelante. En términos geológicos son cosas diminutas, pero insistes que la escala es incorrecta.

entries.source: Inverted hands are soaked in the blood of fauna whose minds were tricked by the patterned bunches of its unbananas. Its fronds are stiffer than its looksake.
entries.translation: Las manos invertidas están empapadas en la sangre de fauna cuyas mentes fueron engañadas por los racimos estampados de sus no-bananas. Sus hojas son más rígidas que su parecido.

entries.source:
Is it a coincidence that the knotted, erumpent throng of organ that is Pax Klanq is shaped in the vague form of a humanoid, or is the prodigy fungus welcoming =pronouns.possessive= extradimensional anthropoid visitors with a warm gesture? In either case, =pronouns.possessive= splendid orange cap looks like a fancy hat. The semblance ends there, however; in place of a face, there's only a trio of undulating tentacles.

At the edges of your field of vision, more tentacles writhe over tools, books, circuitboards, frog cadavers, and saltwater pearls. You realize just how many things Klanq does at once, and you wonder at Nature's decision to bestow peak organic wit to a fungus.
entries.translation:
¿Es una casualidad que el enjambre nudoso y eruptivo de tejido orgánico que es Pax Klanq esté conformado en la vaga figura de un ser humanoide, o acaso el prodigioso hongo está extendiendo una cálida bienvenida a =pronouns.possessive= visitantes antropoides extradimensionales con un gesto amistoso? En cualquier caso, =pronouns.possessive= elegante y anaranjado sombrero parece un sombrero de gala. Sin embargo, la semejanza termina ahí; en lugar de una cara, solo hay tres tentáculos ondulantes.

En los bordes de tu campo visual, más tentáculos se retuercen sobre herramientas, libros, tableros de circuito, cadáveres de ranas y perlas marinas. Te das cuenta de cuántas cosas hace Klanq a la vez, e incluso te preguntas acerca de la decisión de la Naturaleza de otorgar una mente orgánica excepcional a un hongo.

entries.source: It decays and gives off a warm and lovely heat.
entries.translation: Se descompone y emana un calor cálido y hermoso.

entries.source: It glints as it scuttles beneath an alighted exoskeleton of angled glass.
entries.translation: Brilla mientras se arrastra bajo un exoesqueleto iluminado hecho de vidrio angular.

entries.source: It sheaths itself in filmy wings and brandishes a sanguine proboscis.
entries.translation: Se envuelve en alas viscosas y brandea una proboscis sanguínea.

entries.source: It sheaths itself in filmy wings and brandishes a tissue-boring proboscis.
entries.translation: Se envuelve en alas filmosas y brandea una proboscis perforadora de tejidos.

entries.source: It sheaths itself in filmy wings.

It's a robotic half-eye lidded by a furcate chassis and embellished with antenna lashes. A minuscule barrel pokes out from its pupil and vibrates. The inner lid is articulated, allowing the drone to scan for incoming projectiles and shoot them down.
entries.translation: Es un medio ojo robótico cubierto por un chasis bifurcado y adornado con mechones antenales. Un cañón minúsculo sobresale de su pupila y vibra. La tapa interior está articulada, permitiendo al dron escanear proyectiles entrantes y abatirlos.

entries.source: It's a small crossbow with a wide barrel to hold darts.
entries.translation: Es un pequeño arco compuesto con un cilindro ancho para contener dardos.

entries.source: Its monstrous, shelled torso is downside up and sprouts a bouquet of crumpled legs.
entries.translation: Su monstruoso cuerpo acorazado yace invertido y brota un ramo de patas arrugadas.

entries.source: Its torso is downside up and sprouts a bouquet of crumpled legs. Voltaic residuum drips and sizzles.
entries.translation: Su torso está invertido y brota un ramo de piernas arrugadas. Residuos voláicos gotean y chisporrotean.

entries.source: Its torso is downside up and sprouts a bouquet of crumpled, smoldering legs.
entries.translation: Su torso está invertido y brota un ramo de patas arrugadas y humeantes.

entries.source: Its torso is downside up and sprouts a bouquet of spines and crumpled legs.
entries.translation: Su torso está invertido y brota un ramo de espinas y patas arrugadas.

entries.source: Jade gills tense and release, tense and release, tense and release, as if drawing breath into the puffer's stem. With each exhalation it belches a cloud of emerald spores like motes of twilight. They flutter back to the cap and congeal into a jade plasma.
entries.translation: Las branquias de jade se tensan y sueltan, tensan y sueltan, tensan y sueltan, como si aspiraran aliento hacia el tallo del inflable. Con cada exhalación, escupe una nube de esporas verdes como partículas de crepúsculo. Ellas revolotean de vuelta hacia el sombrero y se solidifican en un plasma de jade.

entries.source: Life's blossoming ringlets were freed from their orb-womb of carbon.
entries.translation: Los anillos florales de la vida fueron liberados de su útero-orbe de carbono.

entries.source: Matted fronds sway in the air currents and speckle the ground with flakes of moisture-sucked rust.
entries.translation: Las frondas enmarañadas se balancean con las corrientes de aire y esparcen por el suelo fragmentos de óxido que ha absorbido la humedad.

entries.source: Metameric flesh rings are joined into a line and crammed along a waveform. When one of a trillion-per-second random fluctuations causes the cosmic fabric to ripple, the worm aligns itself to a pattern of constructive interference and is shunted forward.
entries.translation: Anillos de carne metamérica se unen en una línea y se comprimen a lo largo de una onda. Cuando uno de los fluctuantes aleatorios por trillón por segundo hace que el tejido cósmico se estremezca, la larva se alinea con un patrón de interferencia constructiva y es desviada hacia adelante.

entries.source: Minuscule skin crystals shift and sort light to pattern match whatever is outside the body boundary. A narrow bone extrudes from =pronouns.possessive= head.

entries.source: Mirrored chrome spangles gather in waves and break on the seams of the dead-sitter colossus's electroplated chassis. Loose sequins, like free radicals, are sent tumbling by time and earth-pull.
entries.translation: Los destellos de cromo pulido se agrupan en olas y rompen sobre las juntas del casco electroplacado del coloso sentado muerto. Sequines sueltos, como radicales libres, son lanzados al viento por el tiempo y la gravedad terrestre.

entries.source: Mist steams from the cracks between its drying scales.
entries.translation: La niebla hierve desde las grietas entre sus escamas secas.

On =pronouns.possessive= malachine face, two fleece-like lids droop to couch ireful eyes of amber. A guttural boom in the contrabass spectrum drums out of =pronouns.possessive= vocal sac, vibrating the warty webbing on =pronouns.possessive= overgrown toes. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:are:afterpronoun= a chiliad-chewed, mountainous wad of spite.

Muscovite fronds slouch under their mineralic weight. Whatever nears and eclipses its sunlight is flogged for its wrongdoing.

entries.source:
O, she doth pale red apples by her cheek!
That cheek which doth proclaim the rite of spring,
And heretofore hath nature's grand technique,
Ne'er ripened lips so red from which to sing.
Begone, false sun! I know thee for a fraud.
Her fairest skin illuminates the day.
All gold is brass and e'ery jewel is flawed,
When set beside the sums her eyes might pay.
The Spindle, which from Omonporch ascends,
Must surely be her likeness brightly wrought,
And as a likeness, fails to apprehend,
The artless beauty that its makers sought.
Did I know love or beauty? No, for shame!
For I knew neither 'til they spoke her name.
entries.translation:
O, ella lleva manzanas rojas pálidas junto a su mejilla!
Esa mejilla que proclama el rito de la primavera,
Y hasta ahora la grandiosa técnica de la naturaleza,
Nunca ha madurado labios tan rojos desde los cuales cantar.
¡Vete, falso sol! Te conozco como un fraude.
Su piel más hermosa ilumina el día.
Todo el oro es bronce y cada joya está defectuosa,
Cuando se compara con las riquezas que sus ojos podrían pagar.
La Aguja, que asciende desde Omonporch,
Deben ser seguramente su imagen brillantemente tallada,
Y como una imagen, falla en comprender,
La belleza ingenua que sus creadores buscaban.
¿Sabía yo el amor o la belleza? ¡No, por vergüenza!
Porque no conocí ni uno hasta que pronunciaron su nombre.

entries.translation: Océanos de vino ardiente y caliente salpican espuma sobre la esfera interior monstruosa, mientras que la esfera exterior está cubierta por completo con hojas disueltas.

One star-ribboned night, a ray cat crossed the marshy loam and wandered into Joppa. The watervine farmers, wakened by the joyful cries of a small girl, gathered around to revel at the favorable omen and extol the generosity of the Beetle Moon. Since then, Ctesiphus =verb:have= spent =pronouns.possessive= days curled under the shade of brinestalk huts and sauntering over dirt paths. So long as =pronouns.subjective==verb:'re:afterpronoun= approached with care, =pronouns.subjective= =verb:welcome:afterpronoun= the hands of friends and strangers alike.

entries.translation:
Una noche ceñida de cintas estelares, un gato rayado cruzó la tierra pantanosa y se adentró en Joppa. Los cultivadores de watervine, despertados por los alegres gritos de una niña pequeña, se reunieron alrededor para deleitarse con el auspicioso presagio y alabar la generosidad de la Luna Escarabajo. Para =pronouns.objective=, son pequeños marionetas; sus extremidades deben ser dobladas alrededor de sus articulaciones con amorosa precisión, o se extienden abiertas por su propia voluntad, inútiles y rotas.

entries.source: Wide-sheet petals span above a snapjaw's height and thrice as wide. =pronouns.Possessive= stamen looks like a bundle of saltback tongues, and =pronouns.possessive= scent is describable as 'sweaty animal'. Several thorn-touched rhizome pods fidget near =pronouns.possessive= stem like a clutch of eager children.
entries.translation: Amplias pétalos se extienden por encima de la altura de un snapjaw y tres veces su anchura. Las =pronouns.Possessive= anteras parecen un haz de lenguas de sal-back, y el aroma de =pronouns.possessive= es describible como 'animal sudoroso'. Varios pods de rizoma tocados con espinas se mueven cerca de la =pronouns.possessive= tallo, como un grupo de niños ansiosos.

entries.source: Wind presses a sunbleached thawb and neckdress against a humanoid form. The fabric is embroidered to rhyme with patterns in the salt.
entries.translation: El viento aprieta una túnica y un vestido de cuello descoloridos por el sol contra una forma humanaide. El tejido está bordado para rimar con los patrones en la sal.

entries.source: Wire, twine, and thread tangle from spools strapped to =pronouns.possessive= vest. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:sport:afterpronoun= a ruffled cloak of unknown fashion.
entries.translation: Alambres, cuerda y hilo se enredan provenientes de carretes atados al chaleco de =pronouns.possessive=. =pronouns.Subjective= =verb:sport:afterpronoun= lleva una capa ondulada de moda desconocida.

entries.source: Wispy ur-filament wings painted red by oxygen beat the stale air 300 times per second. They lift a thorax bundled out of metallurgic sinew and narrowing to a segmented abdomen capped by a fine-motion pincer claw.
entries.translation: Alas ur-filamento alas, pintadas de rojo por el oxígeno, batían el aire estancado 300 veces por segundo. Levantaban un tórax envuelto en tendones metálicos y que se estrechaba hacia un abdomen segmentado coronado por una pinza de fina movilidad.

entries.source:
Words fail to contain the paradox of =pronouns.possessive= domesticated immensity.

Drifts on the cultural seas have swept a particular fable to your attention. Long ago, far away, folks supposed all of everything rested on the back of a world-tortoise. Surely that flight of fancy came to someone gazing on a Great Saltback... or does your own vision echo through the past to partake in its creation?
entries.translation:
Las palabras se hallan impotentes ante el paradoja de =pronouns.possessive= inmensidad domesticada.

Corrientes en los mares culturales han llevado a tu atención una fábula particular. Hace mucho tiempo, muy lejos, la gente supuso que todo lo existente descansaba sobre la espalda de una tortuga mundial. Seguro que esa fantasía nació en alguien mirando una Gran Salomuela... ¿o acaso tu propia visión resuena a través del pasado para participar en su creación?

entries.source: Wormflesh drags apart into another self. In sunken and lightless grottos of stippled earth, the honeycomb to fossil people, a machine whir overlays the slump of the mantle and activates the primal biology of trash maggots everywhere.
entries.translation: La carne de lombriz se desgarró hacia otro yo. En grotas hundidas y sin luz, en la tierra puntuada, el panal a personas fósiles, una máquina zumbante cubre el desplome del manto y activa la biología primitiva de las moscas de basura por doquier.

entries.source: Years of proximity to the baetyl have blanched the antipriest's irises to chrome. A circuit diagram snakes its way across =pronouns.possessive= body in the mixed media of robe embroidery and skin rime. Unlike the lyrical circuit batches in the second Canticles, this one is a fractal elaboration of itself, blooming under the effect of heretical speciation due to the isolation of the Rock.
entries.translation: Años de proximidad al baetyl han blanqueado las iris del antipriest hasta el cromo. Un diagrama de circuito serpentea a través del cuerpo de =pronouns.possessive= en la mezcla de medios de bordados de hábito y escarcha de piel. A diferencia de los lotes de circuitos líricos en las segundas Canticles, este es una elaboración fractal de sí mismo, floreciendo bajo el efecto de la especiación hereje debido a la aislamiento de la Roca.

entries.source: You nearly mistake it for a boulder, and then you spot a crease in =pronouns.possessive= hide as =pronouns.subjective= =verb:draw:afterpronoun= a slow, hibernative breath. Suddenly you understand the saying among pig farmers: always fear large rocks.
entries.translation: Casi lo confundes con un bloque de piedra, y luego notas una arruga en la piel de =pronouns.possessive= mientras =pronouns.subjective= =verb:draw:afterpronoun= una respiración lenta, hibernante. De repente entiendes el dicho entre criadores de cerdos: siempre teme a las grandes rocas.

entries.source: You stand not at the foot of a wintry knoll but beneath a mountain of muscle, swathed in blanched fur, that must be nature's crowning jewel. Cast from the mold of the great apes (or perhaps the exemplar from which those apes were molded), the living god differs only in that =pronouns.subjective= =verb:bear:afterpronoun= not two but six arms, each of which might be the fleeced bole of an ancient yew. =pronouns.Possessive= fists are of proportions that suggest the might with which hoary gods beat the mountains into shape when the earth was young. However, =pronouns.possessive= aspect bears not a shred of that divine fury; =pronouns.subjective= =verb:don't:afterpronoun= rage but instead =verb:sit:afterpronoun= in contemplation of eons.
entries.translation: No estás ante el pie de una colina invernal, sino bajo una montaña de músculo, envuelta en pelaje blanquecino, que debe ser la joya culminante de la naturaleza. Forjado en el molde de los grandes simios (o tal vez en el ejemplo del cual esos simios fueron forjados), este dios viviente difiere solo en que =pronouns.subjective= =verb:bear:afterpronoun= no dos, sino seis brazos, cada uno de los cuales podría ser el tronco peludo de un antiguo tuya. =pronouns.Possessive= puños tienen proporciones que sugieren la fuerza con la cual los dioses canosos moldearon las montañas cuando la tierra era joven. Sin embargo, =pronouns.possessive= aspecto no muestra ni un solo vestigio de esa furia divina; =pronouns.subjective= =verb:don't:afterpronoun= ira, sino que =verb:sit:afterpronoun= en contemplación de eones.

entries.source: Yurl, a sentient cucumber vine, puts =pronouns.possessive= roots down in a squat clay pot on the floor of =pronouns.possessive= hut. Myriad wares rest on oaken shelves throughout the room, and with =pronouns.possessive= tendrils Yurl =verb:exhibit= them to interested customers by crawling along an iron trellis. You notice that Yurl =verb:creep= toward products almost before you think of them; the gift of telepathy affords the sprightly vine a distinct advantage as a chandler.
entries.translation: Yurl, una enredadera de pepino consciente, entierra =pronouns.possessive= raíces en un jarrón de arcilla cuadrado sobre el suelo de la =pronouns.possessive= cabaña. Multitud de mercancías reposan en estanterías de roble a lo largo de la habitación, y con sus =pronouns.possessive= tentáculos Yurl =verb:exhibit= las hacia clientes interesados arrastrándose por un enrejado de hierro. Te das cuenta de que Yurl =verb:creep= hacia productos casi antes de que siquiera se te ocurra pensar en ellos; el don de la telepatía otorga a la vivaz enredadera una ventaja distintiva como vendedor.

entries.source: A divine crisp dissolves into salted manna.
entries.translation: Una divina crispación se disuelve en maná salado.

entries.source: Beams of snug warmth sprout like fractals inside your body.
entries.translation: Rayos de calor ajustado brotan como fractales desde el interior de tu cuerpo.

entries.source: It crackles on your taste buds.
It crunches into flakes in your mouth.
entries.translation: Se deshace en escamas en tu boca.

entries.source: It tastes awful, but it meets the bare necessities.
entries.translation: Sabe horrible, pero cumple con las necesidades más elementales.

entries.source:
It tastes bitter.
