entries.translation: Mientras explorabas =player.zone.name=, =player.name= recuperó el famoso artefacto llamado =item.the.refname=.

entries.source: While fighting a battle to protect the practice of =spice:elements.$element.practices.!random=, =name= valorously had =player.possessive= =limb.ordinalName= dismembered.
entries.translation: Mientras combatía una batalla para proteger la práctica de =spice:elements.$element.practices.!random=, =name= valerosamente tuvo =player.possessive= =limb.ordinalName= desmembrado.

entries.source: While leading a small army in =region=,
entries.translation: Mientras lideraba un pequeño ejército en =region=,

entries.source: While leading a small army through =zone.prosaic=, =player.name= demanded that a local baetyl use its powers to transmute =demand= into =reward|lower=.
entries.translation: Mientras lideraba un pequeño ejército a través de =zone.prosaic=, =player.name= exigió que un baetyl local usara sus poderes para transmutar =demand= en =reward|lower=.

entries.source: While operational, provides light in radius =radius=.
entries.translation: Mientras esté operativo, proporciona luz en un radio de =radius=.
Mientras esté operativo, proporciona visión nocturna.

entries.source: While operational, provides night vision in radius =radius=.
entries.translation: Mientras esté operativo, proporciona visión nocturna en un radio de =radius=.

entries.source: While traveling alone through the Rust Wells, Resheph came across a trove of gleaming stars in a bottle. From that day forth, he always kept some stardust on his person.
entries.translation: Mientras viajaba solo por las Pozas de Rostro, Resheph topó con un botín de estrellas centelleantes en una botella. Desde aquel día, siempre llevó algo de polvo estelar consigo.

entries.source: While traveling near Bethesda Susa, Resheph lost control of his chariot and drove it off a cliff. Luckily, a local physician named Rebekah came to his rescue. Moved by her kindness, Resheph enrolled at a nearby hospice as her apprentice.
entries.translation: Mientras viajaba cerca de Bethesda Susa, Resheph perdió el control de su carreta y la condujo hacia un precipicio. Afortunadamente, un médico local llamado Rebekah acudió en su auxilio. Conmovido por su bondad, Resheph se inscribió en una hospicia cercana como su aprendiz.

entries.source: While traveling through =region=, =spice.entity:name= stopped at a market in =location=. At an obscure shop, =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= purchased =itemDescription|article= =itemType= and named it =itemName=. Then =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= went to a nearby tavern and lost =itemName= =spice:commonPhrases.lostInTavern.!random=. =spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize= cursed the tavern and left =location=.
entries.translation: Mientras viajaba por =region=, =spice.entity:name= se detuvo en un mercado en =location=. En una tienda oscura, =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= compró =itemDescription|article= =itemType= y lo llamó =itemName=. Luego =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= fue a una taberna cercana y perdió =itemName= =spice:commonPhrases.lostInTavern.!random=. =spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize= maldijo la taberna y abandonó =location=.

entries.source: While traveling through =region=, =spice.entity:name= stopped at a tavern in =location=. There =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= lost =spice.entity:possessivePronoun= prized =itemName= =spice:commonPhrases.lostInTavern.!random=. =spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize= cursed the tavern and left =location=.
entries.translation: Mientras viajaba por =region=, =spice.entity:name= se detuvo en una taberna de =location=. Allí =spice.entity:subjectPronoun= perdió =spice.entity:possessivePronoun= preciado =itemName= =spice:commonPhrases.lostInTavern.!random=. =spice.entity:subjectPronoun|capitalize= maldijo la taberna y abandonó =location=.

entries.source: While traveling through =terrain.t=, =name= stopped at a tavern near =landmark.nearest=. There =subject.they= wisely declined to play a game of dice and instead supped on a nourishing serving of Eaters' nectar.
entries.translation: Mientras viajaba por =terrain.t=, =name= se detuvo en una taberna cerca de =landmark.nearest=. Allí =subject.they= declinó sabiamente jugar un juego de dados e, instead, bebió un servicio nutritivo de néctar de los Devoradores.

entries.source: While visiting an obscure =spice:professions.$profession.guildhall=, =name= met with a group of =spice:professions.$profession.plural= and commissioned what came to be known as =item.the.basename=.
entries.translation: Mientras visitaba un =spice:professions.$profession.guildhall= oculto, =name= se encontró con un grupo de =spice:professions.$profession.plural= y encargó lo que luego sería conocido como =item.the.basename=.

entries.source: While visiting an obscure =spice:professions.$profession.guildhall=, =player.name= met with a group of =spice:professions.$profession.plural= and commissioned what came to be known as =item.the.refname=.
entries.translation: Mientras visitaba un =spice:professions.$profession.guildhall= oculto, =player.name= se encontró con un grupo de =spice:professions.$profession.plural= y encargó lo que luego sería conocido como =item.the.refname=.

entries.source: While wandering around =player.terrain.t=, =name= stumbled upon a clan of machine folk. Because of =player.name's|strip= =spice:elements.$element.quality.!random=, they accepted =player.objective= into their fold and helped =player.objective= Become by installing =cybernetic.a.name|strip=.
entries.translation: Mientras vagaba por =player.terrain.t=, =name= tropezó con una tribu de seres mecánicos. Debido a =player.name's|strip= =spice:elements.$element.quality.!random=, aceptaron a =player.objective= entre ellos y ayudaron a =player.objective= A Convertirse instalando =cybernetic.a.name|strip=.

entries.source: Who ventures into the Great Salt Desert, and nearer the Six Day Stilt?
entries.translation: ¿Quién se aventura en el Gran Desierto Salino, y más cerca del Stilt de los Seis Días?

entries.source: Who would you like to beguile?
Who would you like to proselytize?
Whoever stole Kindrish didn't steal from the village stores. These chests are simply packed with dried lah, vinewafers, and waterskins.
entries.translation: Quienquiera que haya robado a Kindrish no robó de las tiendas del pueblo. Estas cajas están simplemente llenas de lah seco, panes de vid y odres de agua.

entries.source: Why is this village populated with =faction.formattedName=?
entries.translation: ¿Por qué está esta aldea poblada por =faction.formattedName=?

entries.source: Willowy: This item weighs much less than normal.
entries.translation: Delgado como tallo: Este objeto pesa mucho menos de lo normal.

entries.source: With the help of Pax Klanq and the Barathrumites, you constructed =golem.a.name= to climb the Spindle.
entries.translation: Con la ayuda de Pax Klanq y los Barathrumitas, construiste =golem.a.name= para escalar la Aguja.

entries.source: Without a tongue, you cannot proselytize =object.t=, as you cannot make telepathic contact with =object.them=.
entries.translation: Sin una lengua, no puedes proselitizar a =object.t=, ya que no puedes establecer contacto telepático con =object.them=.

entries.source: Without a tongue, you cannot proselytize =object.t=.
entries.translation: Sin una lengua, no puedes proselitizar a =object.t=.

entries.source: Wooly: This item grants resistance to heat and cold.
entries.translation: Lanudo: Este objeto otorga resistencia al calor y al frío.

entries.source: Would you like to save your changes?
Yes. I will =verb= =item.the.basename|strip= as you ask.
Yes. I will find =item.the.name= as you ask.
entries.translation: Sí. Buscaré =item.the.name= tal como me pides.

entries.source: Yes. I will locate =targetLocation.text|colorSafe= as you ask.
You abide the memory of =object.a.or.the==object.shortsingle's= creation. You learn to build =sample.pluralize=.
entries.translation: Abres la memoria de la creación de =object.a.or.the==object.shortsingle's=. Aprendes a construir =sample.pluralize=.

entries.source: You acceded to Resheph's plan to purge the world of higher life in preparation for the Coven's return.
entries.translation: Aceptaste el plan de Resheph para purgar al mundo de vida superior en preparación para el regreso de la Coven.

entries.source: You appeased a baetyl with =demand= and in return received =reward=.
entries.translation: Aplacaste a un baetyl con =demand= y como recompensa recibiste =reward=.

entries.source: You are able to collect =transfer.things:dram= of =volume.liquid.name=. Are you sure you want to?
entries.translation: Puedes recoger =transfer.things:dram= de =volume.liquid.name=. ¿Estás seguro de que quieres hacerlo?

entries.source: You are already wearing a disguise.
You are already within a precognitive vision.
entries.translation: Ya estás dentro de una visión precognitiva.

entries.source: You are also visible to psychic beings from other dimensions.
entries.translation: También eres visible para seres psíquicos provenientes de otras dimensiones.

entries.source: You are drying out! Do you want to stop travelling?
entries.translation: Te estás secando ¡Te estás muriendo de sed! ¿Quieres detenerte en tu viaje?

entries.source: You are dying of thirst! Do you want to stop travelling?
entries.translation: Te estás muriendo de sed. ¿Quieres detenerte en tu viaje?
¡Te has convertido en un bloque de hielo!

entries.source: You are healed for =amount= by the heat.
You are in no shape to start a conversation.
entries.translation: No estás en condiciones de iniciar una conversación.

entries.source: You are not suffering from the onset of a disease.
entries.translation: No sufres del inicio de una enfermedad.

entries.source: You are out of phase with =object.t=.
You are shunted to another location!
You are sucked through the surface of the sphere!
entries.translation: ¡Te succionan a través de la superficie de la esfera!

entries.source: You are too confused to remember what =item.a.name= =item.is.=
entries.translation: Estás demasiado confundido para recordar qué =item.a.name= =item.is.=
No eres capaz de atacar a =target.the.name=.

entries.source: You are unable to drink liquids.
You are unable to drink that.

entries.translation: Estás unido por el agua con =object.objective=.

entries.source: You are welcome in their holy places.
entries.translation: Eres bienvenido en sus lugares sagrados.

entries.source: You aren't familiar enough with any creatures to make a disguise.
entries.translation: No estás lo suficientemente familiarizado con ninguna criatura como para fabricar un disfraz.

entries.source: You aren't hungry. Instead, you relax by the warmth of the fire.
entries.translation: No tienes hambre. En su lugar, te relajas junto al calor de la fogata.

entries.source: You aren't welcome in their holy places.
You ate some Crystal Delight and became a crystalline being.
entries.translation: Comiste algo de Delicia Cristalina y te convertiste en un ser cristalino.
Comiste la Sorpresa de la Cloaca.

entries.source: You boost =object.name's= immunity with a balm made from =cure.a.name:single=.
entries.translation: Fortaleces la inmunidad de =object.name's= con un bálsamo hecho de =cure.a.name:single=.

entries.source: You burrow a channel through the psychic aether to =object.the.name= and begin to sunder =object.its= mind!
entries.translation: Excavas un canal a través del éter psíquico hacia =object.the.name= y comienzas a partir =object.its= mente!

entries.source: You can attack a hostile creature by moving into its square. This is called {{W|bump attacking}}.
entries.translation: Puedes atacar a una criatura hostil moviéndote dentro de su casilla. Esto se llama {{W|ataque por embestida}}.

entries.source: You can name your character or choose Next for a random name.
entries.translation: Puedes darle un nombre a tu personaje o elegir Siguiente para recibir uno aleatorio.

entries.source: You can only =verb= into empty spaces.
You can only build a campfire in the same zone you are in.
entries.translation: Solo puedes encender una fogata en la misma zona en la que te encuentras.

entries.source: You can only teleport to a place you have seen before!
entries.translation: ¡Sólo puedes teletransportarte a un lugar que hayas visto antes!

entries.source: You can't bask with hostiles nearby.
entries.translation: No puedes bañarte bajo el sol con enemigos cercanos.

entries.source: You can't cook with hostile creatures nearby.
entries.translation: No puedes cocinar mientras haya criaturas hostiles cerca.

entries.source: You can't cook with hostiles nearby.
entries.translation: No puedes cocinar con enemigos cerca.

entries.source: You can't do that with hostile creatures nearby.
entries.translation: No puedes hacer eso con criaturas hostiles cerca.

entries.source: You can't dominate someone you are already dominating.
entries.translation: No puedes dominar a alguien que ya estás dominando.

entries.source: You can't excavate with hostiles nearby.
entries.translation: No puedes excavar con hostiles cerca.

entries.source: You can't figure out how to safely reach the stairs from here.
entries.translation: No puedes averiguar cómo llegar seguramente a las escaleras desde aquí.

entries.source: You can't figure out how to wake =object.the.name=.
entries.translation: No puedes averiguar cómo despertar a =object.the.name=.

entries.source: You can't find a way to flee from =object.the.name=.
entries.translation: No puedes encontrar una manera de huir de =object.the.name=.

entries.source: You can't find a way to navigate to =target.the.name=.
entries.translation: No logras encontrar un camino para navegar hacia =target.the.name=.

entries.source: You can't find a way to reach =object.the.name=.
entries.translation: No puedes encontrar una manera de llegar a =object.the.name=.

entries.source: You can't pour from a container into =object.itself=.
entries.translation: No puedes derramar desde un recipiente hacia =object.itself=.

entries.source: You can't remove the old cell!
You can't seem to drink any of the juice from =object.the.name=.
entries.translation: No parece que puedas beber nada del jugo de =object.the.name=.

entries.source: You can't seem to find a way to reach =target.the.name=.
entries.translation: Parece que no encuentras manera de llegar a =target.the.name=.

entries.source: You can't seem to make out what =subject.the.name= =subject.is= saying.
entries.translation: Parece que no puedes entender lo que =subject.the.name= =subject.is= está diciendo.

entries.source: You can't switch primary limbs in combat.
entries.translation: No puedes cambiar tus extremidades principales durante el combate.

entries.source: You can't take the new cell out of your inventory!
entries.translation: No puedes sacar la nueva célula de tu inventario!

entries.source: You can't tinker with hostiles nearby!
entries.translation: ¡No puedes arreglar mientras hay hostiles cerca!

entries.source: You can't travel in this environment.
entries.translation: No puedes viajar en este entorno.
No puedes comprender la explicación de =trader.the.name's|strip=.

entries.source: You can't unlock =object.t= from a distance.
You cannot access someone else's precognitive vision.
entries.translation: No puedes acceder a la visión precognitiva de otro.

entries.source: You cannot alter spacetime through either the normality lattice in your local region or the local region you're trying to interact with, in order to =purpose=.
entries.translation: No puedes alterar el espacio-tiempo mediante la red de normalidad en tu región local o en la región local que estás intentando interactuar, con el fin de =purpose=.

entries.source: You cannot alter spacetime through either the normality lattice in your local region or the local region you're trying to interact with.
entries.translation: No puedes alterar el espacio-tiempo a través de la red de normalidad en tu región local o en la región local que intentas interactuar.

entries.source: You cannot alter spacetime through the normality lattice in the local region, in order to =purpose=.
entries.translation: No puedes alterar el espacio-tiempo a través de la red de normalidad en la región local, con el fin de =purpose=.

entries.source: You cannot alter spacetime through the normality lattice in the local region.
entries.translation: No puedes alterar el espacio-tiempo a través de la red de normalidad en la región local.

entries.source: You cannot autoattack while you are confused.
entries.translation: No puedes atacar automáticamente mientras estás confundido.

entries.source: You cannot do that for some reason.
entries.translation: No puedes hacer eso por alguna razón.

entries.source: You cannot do that from here.
entries.translation: No puedes hacer eso desde aquí.

entries.source: You cannot do that on the world map.
entries.translation: No puedes hacer eso en el mapa del mundo.

entries.source: You cannot do that while burrowed.
entries.translation: No puedes hacer eso mientras estás excavando.

entries.source: You cannot equip items while stuck!
entries.translation: No puedes equipar artículos mientras estás atrapado.

entries.source: You cannot find a path to =object.the.name=.
entries.translation: No puedes encontrar un camino hacia =object.the.name=.

entries.source: You cannot find a path to your destination.
entries.translation: No puedes encontrar un camino hacia tu destino.

entries.source: You cannot find a path toward the =direction.expandedDirection=.
entries.translation: No puedes encontrar un camino hacia la =direction.expandedDirection=.

entries.source: You cannot light =object.the.name= because of the liquid =object.it.is= covered in.
entries.translation: No puedes encender =object.the.name= debido al líquido =object.it.is= que lo cubre.

entries.source: You cannot light =object.the.name= because of the liquid =object.it.is= submerged in.
entries.translation: No puedes encender =object.the.name= debido al líquido =object.it.is= en el que está sumergido.

entries.source: You cannot proselytize without a tongue.
entries.translation: No puedes proselitizar sin una lengua.
No puedes alcanzar a =object.the.name= para atacar a =object.them=.

entries.source: You cannot reach =object.the.name= to bandage =object.its= wounds.
entries.translation: No puede alcanzar a =object.the.name= para vendar las heridas de =object.its=.

entries.source: You cannot rebuke without a tongue.
You cannot remove items while stuck!
entries.translation: No puedes desequipar artículos mientras estás atrapado.
No puedes ver a tu objetivo.

entries.source: You cannot seem to engage =subject.the.name= in conversation.
entries.translation: Parece que no puedes involucrar a =subject.the.name= en una conversación.

entries.source: You cannot seem to interact with =object.the.name= in any way.
entries.translation: Parece que no puedes interactuar con =object.the.name= de ninguna manera.

entries.source: You cannot seem to make contact with =subject.the.name=
entries.translation: Parece que no puedes establecer contacto con =subject.the.name=.

entries.source: You cannot select more than =amount.cardinal= options!
entries.translation: No puedes seleccionar más de =amount.cardinal= opciones!

entries.source: You cannot start a campfire in =pool.the.name=.
entries.translation: No puedes encender una fogata en =pool.the.name=.

entries.source: You cannot sufficiently grasp the mind there to sunder it.
entries.translation: No puedes comprender suficientemente la mente allí para partirla.

entries.source: You cannot travel long distances while burrowed.
entries.translation: No puedes viajar grandes distancias mientras estás excavando.

entries.source: You come upon a yawning pit. Would you like to investigate?
entries.translation: Te encuentras ante una fosa abisal. ¿Te gustaría investigarla?

entries.source: You commit the distinguishing characteristics of =snapshot= to memory.
entries.translation: Usted fija en su memoria las características distintivas de =snapshot=.

entries.source: You create a new recipe for {{|=recipe.name=}}!
entries.translation: Has creado una nueva receta para {{|=recipe.name=}}!

entries.source: You cure =object.name's= =effect.description= with a balm made from =cure.a.name:single=.
entries.translation: Sanas =object.name's= =effect.description= con un bálsamo hecho de =cure.a.name:single=.

entries.source: You cure =object.name's= illness with a balm made from =cure.a.name:single=.
entries.translation: Sanas la enfermedad de =object.name's= con un bálsamo hecho de =cure.a.name:single=.

entries.source: You cure the =result.pluralize:poison= coursing through =object.the.name= with a balm made from =cure.a.name:single=.
entries.translation: Curas el =result.pluralize:poison= que corre por =object.the.name= con un bálsamo hecho de =cure.a.name:single=.

entries.source: You destroyed Resheph and launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars with Barathrum.
entries.translation: Destruíste a Resheph y te lanzaste hacia el cosmos polvoriento para navegar las estrellas con Barathrum.

entries.source: You destroyed Resheph and launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars.
entries.translation: Destruíste a Resheph y te lanzaste al cosmos polvoriento para explorar las estrellas.

entries.source: You destroyed Resheph and returned to Qud to help garden the burgeoning world.
entries.translation: Destruíste a Resheph y regresaste a Qud para ayudar a cultivar al mundo en gestación.

entries.source: You destroyed Resheph to save the burgeoning world but marooned yourself at the North Sheva.
entries.translation: Destruíste a Resheph para salvar al mundo en gestación pero te encallaste en el Norte Sheva.

entries.source: You detect all unidentified artifacts on the local map.
entries.translation: Detectas todos los artefactos no identificados en el mapa local.

entries.source: You detect all unidentified artifacts within a radius of =radius=.
entries.translation: Detectas todos los artefactos no identificados dentro de un radio de =radius=.

entries.source: You discover a lair. Would you like to investigate?
You discover a village. Would you like to investigate?
You discover an abandoned village. Would you like to investigate?
entries.translation: Descubres una aldea abandonada. ¿Te gustaría investigar?

entries.source: You discover some historic ruins. Would you like to investigate?
entries.translation: Descubres algunas ruinas históricas. ¿Te gustaría investigar?

entries.source: You discover something about =snapshot= that was hidden!
entries.translation: Descubres algo sobre =snapshot= que estaba oculto.

entries.source: You discover the abandoned village of =villageName=.
You do not autoattack =object.the.name= because =object.it.is= not hostile to you.
entries.translation: No atacas automáticamente a =object.the.name= porque =object.it.is= no es hostil contigo.

entries.source: You do not have a heavy missile weapon equipped.
entries.translation: No tienes equipada una arma de proyectil pesado.

entries.source: You do not have a missile weapon equipped!
entries.translation: ¡No tienes una arma de misiles equipada!

entries.source: You do not have any unshared secrets about the life of Resheph.
entries.translation: No posees ningún secreto inconfesable sobre la vida de Resheph.

entries.source: You do not have the required {{C|=cost=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= to identify this item.
entries.translation: No tienes el requisito {{C|=cost=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= necesario para identificar este artículo.

entries.source: You do not have the skill associated with that power. Would you like to purchase the required skill?
entries.translation: No posees la habilidad asociada a ese poder. ¿Deseas adquirir la habilidad requerida?

entries.source: You don't have =difference= =difference.pluralize:dram= of fresh water to even up the trade!
entries.translation: No tienes =difference= =difference.pluralize:dram= de agua dulce fresca ni siquiera para equilibrar el trueque!

entries.source: You don't have a high enough reputation with =faction.the.name=.
entries.translation: Tu reputación con =faction.the.name= no es lo suficientemente elevada.

entries.source: You don't have any =bits.bitString= bits, which are required for recharging.
entries.translation: No tienes ningún bit de =bits.bitString=, que son necesarios para recargar.

entries.source: You don't have any item schematics.
entries.translation: No tienes ningún esquema de artículos.

entries.source: You don't have any moddable items.
You don't have any modification schematics.
entries.translation: No tienes ningún esquema de modificación.

entries.source: You don't have anything to preserve.
You don't have enough =quills=! You need at least =minimumQuills= =quills= to =abilityName=
entries.translation: No tienes suficiente =quills=! Necesitas al menos =minimumQuills= =quills= para =abilityName=

entries.source: You don't have enough servings of =ingredientDisplayName=.
You don't have enough skill points to buy that =thing=!
entries.translation: No tienes suficientes puntos de habilidad para comprar ese =thing=!

entries.source: You don't have enough water containers to carry that many drams! Do you want to complete the trade for the =storable= =storable.pluralize:dram= you can store?
entries.translation: No tienes suficientes recipientes de agua para transportar tantos dramas¡ ¿Deseas completar el intercambio solo por los =storable= =storable.pluralize:dram= que puedes almacenar?

entries.source: You don't have enough water containers to carry that many drams! You can store =storable= =storable.pluralize:dram=.
entries.translation: No tienes suficientes recipientes de agua para transportar tantos dramas! Puedes almacenar =storable= =storable.pluralize:dram=.

entries.source: You don't have the Cooking and Gathering skill.
entries.translation: No posees la habilidad de Cocina y Recolección.

entries.source: You don't have the Tinkering skill.
entries.translation: No posees la habilidad de Ensamblaje.

entries.source: You don't have the required ingredient: =ingredientList.orlist=
You don't have the required ingredient: =ingredients.orList=!
You don't have the required skill: =skill=!
You don't own =container.the.name:withIndicativeProximal=. Are you sure you want to take =object.the.name=?
entries.translation: No posees =container.the.name:withIndicativeProximal=. ¿Estás seguro de que deseas tomar =object.the.name=?

entries.source: You don't see any hostiles nearby.
You eat the meal. It's tastier than usual.
entries.translation: Comes la comida. Es más sabrosa que de costumbre.

entries.source: You embark for the caves of Qud.
entries.translation: Embarcas hacia las cuevas de Qud.

entries.source: You entered into a covenant with Resheph to help prepare Qud for the Coven's return.
entries.translation: Te comprometiste en un pacto con Resheph para ayudar a preparar Qud para el regreso de la Coven.

entries.source: You experience a sense memory of roasted boar smell. Would you like to investigate?
entries.translation: Experimentas una memoria sensorial del olor a cerdo asado. ¿Te gustaría investigar?

entries.source: You fail to outshine the current object of =object.the.name's= affection.
entries.translation: Fallas en sobresalir al objeto actual de afecto de =object.the.name's=.

entries.source: You fall down a deep shaft!
You feel a psychic thud as =object.does:push= against the structure of spacetime and =object.verb:fail= to break through.
entries.translation: Sientes un golpe psíquico al chocar =object.does:push= contra la estructura del espacio-tiempo y =object.verb:fail= para romper a través.

entries.source: You feel a psychic thud as someone pushes against the structure of spacetime and fails to break through.
entries.translation: Sientes un golpe psíquico al sentir cómo alguien empuja contra la estructura del espacio-tiempo y falla en romperla.

entries.source: You feel a psychic whiff as =object.does:push= past resistance in the structure of spacetime.
entries.translation: Sientes un leve aviso psíquico mientras =object.does:push= traspasa la resistencia en la estructura del espacio-tiempo.

entries.source: You feel a psychic whiff as someone pushes past resistance in the structure of spacetime.
entries.translation: Sientes un leve aviso psíquico mientras alguien empuja contra la resistencia en la estructura del espacio-tiempo.

entries.source: You feel a sense of holiness here.
entries.translation: Sientes una sensación de santidad aquí.

entries.source: You feel a small ripple in space and time.
entries.translation: Sientes una pequeña ondulación en el espacio y el tiempo.

entries.source: You feel an uncomfortable pressure across the length of your body.
entries.translation: Sientes una presión incómoda a lo largo de la longitud de tu cuerpo.

entries.source: You feel like you forgot something important.
entries.translation: Sientes como si hubieras olvidado algo importante.

entries.source: You feel some ambient astral friction here.
entries.translation: Aquí percibes cierta fricción astral ambiental.

entries.source: You feel stiff as a stone.
entries.translation: Te sientes rígido como una piedra.
Sientes que tus huesos se agrietan.

entries.source: You flush with understanding of the =object.isplural:artifacts':artifact's= past and determine =object.them= to be =object.a.name:single=.
entries.translation: Te llenas de comprensión sobre el =object.isplural:artifacts':artifact's= pasado y determinas que =object.them= sea =object.a.name:single=.

entries.source: You freed the Spindle for another's ascent and crossed into Brightsheol.
entries.translation: Liberaste a la Aguja para el ascenso de otro y cruzaste hacia Brightsheol.

entries.source: You gorge on the succulent meat. It's tastier than usual.
entries.translation: Te empollas con la carne jugosa. Es más sabrosa de lo habitual.

entries.source: You have a flash of insight and scribe =object.a.name:long=.
entries.translation: Tienes una chispa de intuición y escribes =object.a.name:long=.

entries.source: You have gained the activated ability {{Y|=abilityName=}}.
You have lost the use of your =part.ordinalName=.
entries.translation: Has perdido el uso de tu =part.ordinalName=.

entries.source: You have no =liquid.name|strip= to supply =host.the.name= with.
You have no artifacts to give.
entries.translation: No posees ningún artefacto para dar.

entries.source: You have no cells that fit.
entries.translation: No tienes ninguna célula que encaje.

entries.source: You have no containers to fill.
entries.translation: No posee ningún recipiente para llenar.

entries.source: You have no containers to pour from.
entries.translation: No tienes recipientes desde los cuales verter.

entries.source: You have no existing saved games.
You have no items that require charging.
entries.translation: No tienes artículos que requieran carga.

entries.source: You have no medicinal ingredients with which to treat =object.name's= =effect.description=.
entries.translation: No tienes ingredientes medicinales con los que tratar la enfermedad de =object.name's= =effect.description=.

entries.source: You have no medicinal ingredients with which to treat =object.name's= illness.
entries.translation: No posee ingredientes medicinales con los cuales tratar la enfermedad de =object.name's=.

entries.source: You have no medicinal ingredients with which to treat the poison coursing through =object.the.name=.
entries.translation: No posees ingredientes medicinales con los que tratar el veneno que corre por =object.the.name=.

entries.source: You have no shield to raise.
You have nothing that meets the requirement of the =selection=.
entries.translation: No posees nada que cumpla con el requisito del =selection=.

entries.source: You have nowhere available to collect that.
entries.translation: No tienes lugar disponible para recoger eso.

entries.source: You have recovered the use of your =part.ordinalName=.
entries.translation: Has recuperado el uso de tu =part.ordinalName=.

entries.source: You have run out of {{B|water}}! Do you want to stop travelling?
entries.translation: ¡Te has quedado sin {{B|agua}}! ¿Quieres detenerte en tu viaje?

entries.source: You have spent too many attribute points!
entries.translation: Has gastado demasiados puntos de atributos.

entries.source: You have spent too many mutation points.
entries.translation: Has gastado demasiados puntos de mutación.
Tienes puntos de atributos no asignados.
Tienes puntos de mutación no gastados.

entries.source: You hear a loud click from across the room.
entries.translation: Oyes un fuerte clic proveniente del otro extremo de la habitación.

entries.source: You hear a muffled grunting coming from inside the block of ice.
entries.translation: Oyes un gruñido ahogado proveniente del interior del bloque de hielo.

entries.source: You hold the =faction.rankTerm= of =rank= among them.
You installed =cybernetic.isPlural:some:a= cybernetic =cybernetic.basename= and came one step closer to the Grand Unification.
entries.translation: Instalaste una cibernética =cybernetic.isPlural:some:a= =cybernetic.basename= y te acercaste un paso más a la Gran Unificación.

entries.source: You invented a mouthwatering dish called {{|=recipe.name=}}!
entries.translation: Has inventado un plato delicioso y apetitoso llamado {{|=recipe.name=}}!

entries.source: You know auntie Eskhind's little sister, Liihart? She's always been quiet, but she didn't talk at all for, uh, two whole weeks before they left!
entries.translation: ¿Conoces a la pequeña hermana de tía Eskhind, Liihart? Siempre ha sido callada, pero no habló en absoluto durante, eh, dos semanas enteras antes de que se fueran!

entries.source: You know, Grand-Doe spent some late nights working on something she wouldn't talk about. I wonder what that was.
entries.translation: Sabes, la Gran Zorra pasó algunas noches tardías trabajando en algo del que no quiso hablar. Me pregunto qué podría haber sido eso.

entries.source: You launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars with Barathrum.
entries.translation: Te lanzaste al cosmos polvoriento para explorar las estrellas junto con Barathrum.

entries.source: You launched yourself into the dusted cosmos to ply the stars.
entries.translation: Te lanzaste al cosmos polvoriento para explorar las estrellas.

entries.source: You lay your hand upon =object.t= and draw forth =object.its= passcode. You enter the code and =object.does:unlock=.
entries.translation: Pones tu mano sobre =object.t= y extraes el pascode =object.its=. Introduces la secuencia y =object.does:unlock=.

entries.source: You let inspiration guide you toward a mouthwatering dish.
entries.translation: Permites que la inspiración te guíe hacia un plato delicioso y apetitoso.

entries.source: You lose {{rules|1}} point of Willpower permanently.

You make some progress understanding =snapshot=. =snapshotDoesSeem= to be =object.a.name:single=, and you think =object.it.is= probably a variety of =sample.basename:asIfKnown=; you believe you would be able to recognize an ordinary =sample.one.of.those= now.
entries.translation: Haces algún progreso en comprender =snapshot=. =snapshotDoesSeem= parece ser =object.a.name:single=, y crees que =object.it.is= probablemente es una variedad de =sample.basename:asIfKnown=; piensas que ahora podrías reconocer fácilmente un =sample.one.of.those= ordinario.

entries.source: You make some progress understanding =snapshot=. =snapshotDoesSeem= to be =object.a.name:single=.
entries.translation: Haces algún progreso en comprender =snapshot=. =snapshotDoesSeem= parece ser =object.a.name:single=.

entries.source: You make some progress understanding =snapshot=. You think =object.it.is= probably a variety of =sample.basename:asIfKnown=, and you believe you would be able to recognize an ordinary =sample.one.of.those= now.
entries.translation: Haces algún progreso en comprender =snapshot=. Crees que =object.it.is= probablemente es una variedad de =sample.basename:asIfKnown=, y crees que ahora podrías reconocer fácilmente un =sample.one.of.those= ordinario.

entries.source: You may identify this for =cost= =cost.pluralize:dram= of fresh water.
entries.translation: Puedes identificar esto para =cost= =cost.pluralize:dram= de agua fresca.

entries.source: You may not learn this skill if you already have =skill.name=.
entries.translation: No podrás aprender esta habilidad si ya posees =skill.name=.

entries.source: You may not learn this skill if you have =mutation.name=.
entries.translation: No podrás aprender esta habilidad si posees =mutation.name=.

entries.source: You may not learn this skill until you have =mutation.name=.
entries.translation: No podrás aprender esta habilidad hasta que poseas =mutation.name=.

entries.source: You may not learn this skill until you have =skillname=.
entries.translation: No podrás aprender esta habilidad hasta que poseas =skillname=.

entries.source: You may not teleport =object.the.name= with Teleport Other!
entries.translation: No puedes teletransportar a =object.the.name= con Teletransportar Otro.

entries.source: You may not {{Y|w}}alk into a hostile creature!
entries.translation: ¡No puedes caminar hacia una criatura hostil!

entries.source: You may only select a visible square!
entries.translation: Solo puedes seleccionar un cuadrado visible!

entries.source: You may only select an explored square!
entries.translation: Solo puedes seleccionar un cuadrado explorado!

entries.source: You may only teleport into an empty square!
entries.translation: ¡Sólo puedes teletransportarte a un cuadrado vacío!

entries.source: You may recharge =object.isplural:one of :==object.indicativeDistal= for {{C|=cost.cardinal=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= of fresh water.
entries.translation: Puedes recargar =object.isplural:one of :==object.indicativeDistal= por {{C|=cost.cardinal=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= de agua fresca.

entries.source: You may repair =multiple.if:those:this= for {{C|=cost=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= of fresh water.
entries.translation: Puedes reparar =multiple.if:those:this= por {{C|=cost=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= de agua fresca.

entries.source: You may walk freely over webs.
entries.translation: Puedes caminar libremente sobre telas de araña.

entries.source: You muse over the =numShared.pluralize:secret= with =object.name|strip= and gain some insight.
entries.translation: Meditas sobre el =numShared.pluralize:secret= junto con =object.name|strip= y adquieres cierta intuición.

entries.source: You must have an axe equipped in your primary hand to dismember.
entries.translation: Debes tener un hacha equipada en tu mano principal para desmembrar.

entries.source: You must have an axe equipped in your primary hand to use Hook and Drag.
entries.translation: Debes tener un hacha equipada en tu mano principal para usar Enganche y Arrastrar.

entries.source: You must make a selection before advancing.
entries.translation: Debes realizar una selección antes de avanzar.

entries.source: You must select a location within =range.things:tile=!
entries.translation: Debes elegir una ubicación dentro de =range.things:tile=!

entries.source: You muster your will and shake off some of your confusion.
entries.translation: Recobras tu voluntad y sacudas algo de tu confusión.

entries.source: You muster your will and shake off your confusion.
entries.translation: Recobras tu voluntad y sacudas tu confusión.

entries.source: You need =hasAny.if:another:a= free =slotType= slot to equip that!
entries.translation: Necesitas =hasAny.if:another:a= ranura libre de =slotType= para equiparlo ¡ahora!

entries.source: You need a dram of =liquids.either.or= to desecrate a shrine.
entries.translation: Necesitas un dram de =liquids.either.or= para profanar un santuario.

entries.source: You need another =shortBy.cardinal= free =bodyPartType.type= slots to equip that!
entries.translation: Necesitas otras =shortBy.cardinal= ranuras libres de =bodyPartType.type= para equiparlo.

entries.source: You need another =shortBy.cardinal= free =slotType= slots to equip that!
entries.translation: Necesitas otra =shortBy.cardinal= ranura libre de =slotType= para equiparlo.

entries.source: You need another free =bodyPartType.type= slot to equip that!
entries.translation: Necesitas otra ranura libre de =bodyPartType.type= para equiparlo.

entries.source: You need at least =amount= charge to generate a discharge.
entries.translation: Necesitas al menos =amount= carga para generar una descarga.

entries.source: You need sunlight to bask in.
entries.translation: Necesitas luz solar para bañarte en ella.

entries.source: You need {{C|=cost.cardinal=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= of fresh water to charge =object.isplural:one of :==object.indicativeDistal=.
entries.translation: Necesitas {{C|=cost.cardinal=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= de agua fresca para cargar =object.isplural:one of :==object.indicativeDistal=.

entries.source: You need {{C|=cost=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= of fresh water to repair =multiple.if:those:that=.
entries.translation: Necesitas {{C|=cost=}} =cost.pluralize:dram= de agua fresca para reparar =multiple.if:those:that=.

entries.source: You notice some ruins nearby. Would you like to investigate?
entries.translation: Notas algunas ruinas cercanas. ¿Te gustaría investigar?

entries.source: You now have =total= feet of copper wire.
entries.translation: Ahora posees =total= pies de alambre de cobre.

entries.source: You now owe =trader.t= =owe= =owe.pluralize:dram= of fresh water.
You open the box and expose the compressed foamcrete to air. It starts to expand.
entries.translation: Abrís la caja y exponéis el espumaconcreto comprimido al aire. Comienza a expandirse.

entries.source: You pony up =available= =available.pluralize:dram= of fresh water, and now owe =trader.the.name|strip= =owe= =owe.pluralize:dram=.
entries.translation: Tomas =available= =available.pluralize:dram= de agua fresca, y ahora debes =trader.the.name|strip= =owe= =owe.pluralize:dram=.

entries.source: You pony up =difference= =difference.pluralize:dram= of fresh water to even up the trade
entries.translation: Tienes que entregar =difference= =difference.pluralize:dram= de agua fresca para igualar el trueque

entries.source: You rebuked Resheph and returned to Qud to help garden the burgeoning world.
entries.translation: Reprochaste a Resheph y regresaste a Qud para ayudar a cultivar al mundo en gestación.

entries.source: You recover the Mark of Death of the late sultanate.
entries.translation: Recuperas la Mark of Death del tardío sultanato.

entries.source: You rejoiced in a drop of nectar.
entries.translation: Te alegraste con una gota de néctar.

entries.source: You restored functionality to one of the four strange entities in the Tomb.
entries.translation: Has restaurado la funcionalidad a una de las cuatro entidades extrañas en la Tumba.

entries.source: You sense a subtle psychic disturbance.
You sense your imminent demise. Would you like to return to the start of your vision?
entries.translation: Sientes tu inminente muerte. ¿Deseas regresar al comienzo de tu visión?

entries.source: You shake the water from your addled brain, but someone else's thoughts have already taken root.
entries.translation: Sacudes el agua de tu enmarañada mente, pero ya han echado raíces los pensamientos ajenos.

entries.source: You should view the tooltip before equipping the axe.
entries.translation: Deberías examinar la viñeta antes de equipar el hacha.

entries.source: You slew your bonded kith =object.a.name:withTitles=, violating the covenant of the water ritual and earning the emnity of all.
entries.translation: Matas a tu kith vinculado =object.a.name:withTitles=, violando el pacto del rito acuático y ganándote la enemistad de todos.

entries.source: You smell roasted boar nearby. Would you like to investigate?
entries.translation: Hueles cerdo asado cerca. ¿Te gustaría investigar?

entries.source: You staunch the wounds of =object.the.name=, though some are too deep to treat.
entries.translation: Detienes las heridas de =object.the.name=, aunque algunas son demasiado profundas para ser tratadas.

entries.source: You staunch your wounds, though some are too deep to treat.
entries.translation: Detienes tus propias heridas, aunque algunas son demasiado profundas para ser tratadas.

entries.source: You strain to part the veil of time in order to use psychometry on =object.the.name:single=, but you are too confused.
entries.translation: Te esfuerzas para rasgar el velo del tiempo con el fin de emplear psicometría sobre =object.the.name:single=, pero estás demasiado confundido.

entries.source: You strain to part the veil of time in order to use psychometry on =object.the.name:single=, but your psyche is too exhausted.
entries.translation: Te esfuerzas para rasgar el velo del tiempo con el fin de emplear psicometría sobre =object.the.name:single=, pero tu psique está demasiado agotada.

entries.source: You swell with inspiration to cook a mouthwatering meal.
entries.translation: Te hinchas de inspiración para cocinar una comida deliciosa.

entries.source: You tighten your =carapace.name=. Your AV increases by {{G|=tightFactor.name=}}.
entries.translation: Ajustas tu =carapace.name=. Tu AV aumenta en {{G|=tightFactor.name=}}.

entries.source: You touch the chiming rock. White noise carries on a distant wind.
entries.translation: Tocas la roca que suena. El ruido blanco se lleva en un viento distante.

entries.source: You touched the chiming rock and attuned to Chavvah, the Tree of Life.
entries.translation: Tocaste la roca que resuena y te afinaste con Chavvah, el Árbol de la Vida.

entries.source: You try to boost =object.name's= immunity with a balm made from =cure.a.name:single=, but it is ineffective.
entries.translation: Tratas de fortalecer la inmunidad de =object.name's= con un bálsamo hecho de =cure.a.name:single=, pero es ineficaz.

entries.source: You try to cure =object.name's= disease onset, but cannot affect =object.them=.
entries.translation: Tratas de sanar el inicio de la enfermedad =object.name's=, pero no puedes afectar a =object.them=.

entries.source: You try to cure =object.name's= disease onset, but your limbs pass through =object.them=.
entries.translation: Tratas de sanar el inicio de la enfermedad =object.name's=, pero tus extremidades atraviesan =object.them=.

entries.source: You try to cure =object.name's= illness, but cannot affect =object.them=.
entries.translation: Tratas de sanar la enfermedad de =object.name's=, pero no puedes influir en =object.them=.

entries.source: You try to cure =object.name's= illness, but your limbs pass through =object.them=.
entries.translation: Ud. intenta curar la enfermedad de =object.name's=, pero sus extremidades pasan a través de =object.them=.

entries.source: You try to cure the poison coursing through =object.the.name=, but cannot affect =object.them=.
entries.translation: Tratas de curar el veneno que corre por =object.the.name=, pero no puedes afectar a =object.them=.

entries.source: You try to cure the poison coursing through =object.the.name=, but your cures are ineffective.
entries.translation: Tratas de curar el veneno que corre por =object.the.name=, pero tus remedios son ineficaces.

entries.source: You try to cure the poison coursing through =object.the.name=, but your limbs pass through =object.them=.
entries.translation: Tratas de curar el veneno que corre por =object.the.name=, pero tus extremidades atraviesan =object.them=.

entries.source: You try to push through the normality lattice, but it snaps back into place.
entries.translation: Tratas de empujar a través de la red de lo normal, pero esta se deshace y vuelve a su lugar.

entries.source: You try to push through the normality lattice, but it snaps back into place. You wince in pain.
entries.translation: Tratas de empujar a través de la red de normalidad, pero esta vuelve a su lugar con un chasquido. Te encorvas debido al dolor.

entries.source: You try to staunch the wounds of =object.the.name=, but cannot affect =object.them=.
entries.translation: Tratas de detener las heridas de =object.the.name=, pero no puedes afectar a =object.them=.

entries.source: You try to staunch the wounds of =object.the.name=, but your limbs pass through =object.them=.
entries.translation: Tratas de detener las heridas de =object.the.name=, pero tus extremidades pasan a través de =object.them=.

entries.source: You violated the Pauli exclusion principle.
entries.translation: Has violado el principio de exclusión de Pauli.

entries.source: You will not auto-attack =target.the.name= because =target.it.is= not hostile to you.
entries.translation: No atacarás automáticamente a =target.the.name= porque =target.it.is= no son hostiles contigo.

entries.source: You will phase back in in =duration.things:round=.
You woke from a fitful dream.
entries.translation: Te levantaste de un sueño inquieto.

entries.source: You woke from a peaceful dream.
entries.translation: Te despertaste de un sueño pacífico.

entries.source: You'll have to pony up =difference= =difference.pluralize:dram= of fresh water to even up the trade. Agreed?
entries.translation: Tendrás que desembolsar =difference= =difference.pluralize:dram= de agua fresca para equilibrar el trueque. ¿De acuerdo?

entries.source: You're in a pocket dimension with no worldmap.
entries.translation: Estás en una dimensión oculta sin mapa del mundo.

entries.source: You're lost! Regain your bearings by exploring your surroundings.
entries.translation: ¡Estás perdido! Recupera tu orientación explorando tus alrededores.

entries.source: You're ready to continue the journey on your own, but don't hesitate to play the tutorial again if you need a refresher.
entries.translation: Estás listo para continuar el viaje por tu cuenta, pero no dudes en volver a jugar la tutoría si necesitas un recordatorio.

entries.source: You're too famished to travel long distances.
entries.translation: Estás demasiado hambriento para viajar grandes distancias.

entries.source: Your =attribute.statCapDisplayName= isn't high enough to buy =powerEntry.name=!
entries.translation: Tu =attribute.statCapDisplayName= no es lo suficientemente elevado como para adquirir =powerEntry.name=!

entries.source: Your =bodyPartType|lower= is too damaged to do that!
entries.translation: Tu =bodyPartType|lower= está demasiado dañado para hacer eso!

entries.source: Your =part.ordinalName= =part.is= too damaged to do that!
entries.translation: Tu =part.ordinalName= =part.is= está demasiado dañado para hacer eso!

entries.source: Your arms shrink into your torso.
entries.translation: Tus brazos se encogen hacia tu torso.

entries.source: Your attack fails to penetrate =object.the.name's:withTitles= mental defenses.
entries.translation: Tu ataque no logra penetrar las defensas mentales de =object.the.name's:withTitles=.

entries.source: Your chance to block with shields is increased by 25%.
entries.translation: Tu probabilidad de bloquear con escudos aumenta un 25%.

entries.source: Your concentration slips and the channel between you and =object.the.name= dissipates into aether.
entries.translation: Tu concentración se desvía y el canal entre tú y =object.the.name= se disuelve en éter.

entries.source: Your concentration slips and the channel dissipates.
entries.translation: Tu concentración se desvía y el canal se disipa.

entries.source: Your focus returns to the present.
Your focus slips, causing you to dent spacetime in the local region.
entries.translation: Tu enfoque se desvía, causando que dentes el espacio-tiempo en la región local.

entries.source: Your genome has already undergone this transformation.
entries.translation: Tu genoma ya ha sufrido esta transformación.

entries.source: Your head is too sensitive to wear that.
entries.translation: Tu cabeza es demasiado sensible para usar eso.
Tu salud ha caído por debajo de {{C|=threshold=%}}!

entries.source: Your health is too weak to do that.
entries.translation: Tu salud es demasiado débil para hacer eso.

entries.source: Your hear a swelling thpthp sound.
entries.translation: Oyes un sonido que crece, thpthp.

entries.source: Your heart sang at the sight of =object.a.name=.
entries.translation: Tu corazón cantó al ver a =object.a.name=.

entries.source: Your legs ache at the joints.
entries.translation: Tus piernas te duelen en las articulaciones.

entries.source: Your limbs suddenly feel perversely round and bumpy before they shrink back into your body.
entries.translation: De repente, tus extremidades se sienten perversamente redondas y rugosas antes de encogerse nuevamente dentro de tu cuerpo.

entries.source: Your mind begins to morph but the physiology of your brain restricts it.
entries.translation: Tu mente comienza a transformarse, pero la fisiología de tu cerebro lo restringe.
Tu mente quedó atrapada dentro de =subject.refname:withIndefiniteArticle:withTitles|strip=.

entries.source: Your mod configuration has changed, do you want to apply your changes and restart the game?
entries.translation: Tu configuración del módulo ha cambiado, ¿deseas aplicar tus cambios y reiniciar el juego?

entries.source: Your mutant physiology reacts adversely to the tonic. You erupt into flames!
entries.translation: Tu fisiología mutante reacciona adversamente al tonico. Te erizas en llamas!

entries.source: Your new pet is ready to love.
entries.translation: Tu nueva mascota está lista para recibir cariño.

entries.source: Your precognition is about to run out. Would you like to return to the start of your vision?
entries.translation: Pronto se agotará tu precognición. ¿Deseas regresar al comienzo de tu visión?

entries.source: Your psychic glimmer represents how noticeable you are in the vast psychic aether. As your mental mutations increase in level, so does your psychic glimmer and the frequency, strength, and number of those who desire to absorb your mind.
entries.translation: Tu destello psíquico representa cuán notorio eres en el vasto éter psíquico. A medida que aumentan los niveles de tus mutaciones mentales, así lo hace tu destello psíquico y la frecuencia, intensidad y número de aquellos que anhelan absorber tu mente.

entries.source: Your sense of self is pulled apart by what feels like a billion years of geologic pressure.
entries.translation: Tu sentido de identidad es arrancado por lo que parece ser la presión geológica de billones de años.

entries.source: Your stomach swells with a burning sensation.
entries.translation: Tu estómago se hincha con una sensación ardiente.

entries.source: Your type of creature may not buy =subject.mutationTerm|pluralize=.
